B2B Lead Researcher — Fixed-Price Project



Maid 4 Janitorial is hiring a B2B lead researcher to build a verified list of commercial prospects in the St. Louis, Missouri area.



Project Pay



* First 100 approved leads: **$25**

* Remaining 400 approved leads: **$100**

* Total: **500 approved leads for $125**

* Rate: **$0.25 per accepted lead**



Payment is issued only after the leads are verified and approved.



Fake, incorrect, duplicate, incomplete, outdated, or out-of-area information will not be paid. Rejected leads must be replaced at no additional cost.



Required Information



Each lead must include:



* Business name

* Full business address

* Website

* Exact job title

* Professional

* Phone number



Target Businesses

* Medical and dental offices

* Apartment communities and property-management offices

* Professional offices

* Spas, med spas, and wellness centers

* Car dealerships

* Other approved commercial business categories

Before beginning any research batch, you must:



1. Check our master pipeline sheet to confirm the businesses have not already been added.

2. Tell us which business category you plan to research.

3. Receive written approval before starting.



Any research completed without prior category approval will not be accepted or paid.

Escalate complex cases when necessary.

Maintain accurate reports of customer interactions.

Knowledge of Parcel Panel, 17Track, or shipping platforms.

Experience handling supplier communications.

Career growth opportunities.

title: Amazon Private Label Product Researcher
description:
Job Title: Amazon Product Researcher (Private Label Business)

Job Description:

We are a growing Amazon FBA private label business focused on launching practical, well-differentiated consumer products across multiple categories. Our approach emphasizes steady expansion through thoughtful product selection, strong supplier relationships, and continuous iteration on existing listings.

We are looking to hire a Product Researcher to identify new product opportunities that meet clear demand, have manageable competition, and align with our brand standards. This role also involves working directly with suppliers to source and help design products.

Responsibilities:

Conduct product research using tools such as Helium 10 (or similar)

Identify viable product opportunities based on demand, competition, and profitability

Analyze search trends, keyword data, and competitor listings

Communicate with suppliers to source products and request quotes/samples

Collaborate on product improvements, variations, and basic design direction

Provide clear, data-backed recommendations

Requirements:

Experience with Amazon product research for private label sellers

Familiarity with research tools (Helium 10, Jungle Scout, etc.)

Experience communicating with suppliers (e.g., Alibaba)

Strong command of written and spoken English

Strong analytical skills and attention to detail

Ability to present findings clearly and concisely

Reliable, organized, and consistent

To Apply:

Please respond with a brief summary of your relevant experience, the tools you use, and 1–2 examples of products you have researched or launched.

title: Amazon Product Sourcing Analyst (Private Label Expansion)
description:
???? Amazon Product Sourcing Analyst (Private Label Growth)

We are a growing Amazon private label business building a portfolio of high-quality, profitable products.

We are not looking for a typical VA.

We are looking for a sharp, analytical thinker who can identify real product opportunities — not just copy what already exists.

If your approach to product research is browsing Alibaba or sending trending items, this role is not for you.

???? What This Role Actually Requires

Your job is to find products we can realistically launch and win with.

That means:

Understanding demand vs competition

Identifying weaknesses in existing listings

Seeing opportunities others miss

Thinking in terms of differentiation, not imitation

You will be expected to justify your ideas with clear, logical reasoning — not guesses.

???? Responsibilities

Identify high-potential product opportunities (non-saturated, scalable)

Analyze Amazon search results, listings, and customer reviews

Find gaps in the market (quality issues, missing features, poor branding, etc.)

Propose clear differentiation strategies

Suggest bundles, variations, or positioning angles

Evaluate pricing, competition, and demand

???? Daily Output Expectations

You will submit 3–5 product ideas per day.

Each idea must include:

Product name + Amazon links to competitors

Estimated selling price

Why demand exists

Why the competition is beatable

A clear and realistic differentiation angle

Optional: sourcing or cost insights

Low-quality or random ideas will not be accepted.

???? Requirements

You must:

Have real experience with Amazon FBA product research

Be familiar with tools such as Helium 10, Jungle Scout, etc.

Write clearly in English

Think critically and explain your reasoning

You should understand:

What makes a market saturated vs opportunity

Basic Amazon economics (fees, margins, pricing)

How to evaluate listings and reviews for weaknesses

? Do Not Apply If

You rely on “trending product” lists

You send random Alibaba links without analysis

You cannot explain your reasoning clearly

You have never done real Amazon product research

???? Compensation

$4–$6/hour to start

2–4 hours per day (part-time)

Performance-based bonuses will be given for product ideas we actually launch.

Top performers will quickly earn more responsibility and higher pay.

???? Required Test Task (Mandatory)

To be considered:

Start your application with the word: Growth

Then complete the following:

Find 3 product ideas in the kitchen or home category that:

Sell between $20–$50

Have consistent demand

Are not oversaturated

For each idea, include:

Amazon links

Why this is a strong opportunity

How we would differentiate and win

Applications without this will be ignored.

???? Opportunity

We are actively expanding and plan to launch many new products.

This role can grow into:

Product lead

Launch manager

Long-term strategic role

title: Part-Time Video Editor - Movie Recaps (Long-Term / Hyper-Sharp Quality)
description:
Hello,I am looking for a talented, highly skilled, and creative video editor specializing in the Movie Recap / Film Summary niche for our YouTube and TikTok channels. This is a long-term collaboration.This is a stable, part-time position (approx. 20 to 25 hours per week, Monday to Saturday). Extreme punctuality and reliability are top priorities for us.The Workload & Pacing:Editing 3 videos per day from Monday to Saturday (18 videos per week in total). Our final videos are short and dynamic, usually ranging between 1 to 3 minutes 
pending on your experience and skill, this should take you about 1 hour to 1.5 hours per video.Important - Language Requirement:Our main target audience is Spanish-speaking. Therefore, our absolute priority is an editor who can work with Spanish audio and 
te: If you do not speak Spanish but meet all our technical and visual requirements, we are open to running a 15 to 20-day trial editing in English to see how the audience reacts. This trial will be fully paid at the regular rate. If the English channel works, it becomes long-term; if it doesn't, we will return to a Spanish-focused workflow.Technical, Format & Copyright Requirements:Copyright Safe Editing (Crucial): You must strictly understand how to edit to avoid copyright claims, content ID flags, or disqualifications. This means no long unedited clips; you must use fast cuts and smart framing.The Format & Hook: The video must start with a very short, powerful visual hook in the first few seconds using strategic movie scenes. Use a third-person narration (voiceover) to guide the story, seamlessly weaving in the movie characters 
aracter Dialogues: The parts where the characters speak are the most important to engage the audience, but they must be kept short (just a few seconds per cut) to avoid copyright issues.Hyper-Sharp & Ultra-Detailed Look: We need an ultra-crisp visual style. Faces, hair, and clothing textures must look heavily defined with sharp, clean edges (a basic 4K export is not enough; the footage must look enhanced and premium).High-Contrast Cinematic Color Grading: Deep shadows, vibrant yet clean skin tones, and a high-contrast look that perfectly separates the characters from the background.Originality: Bring your own fresh editing style. We want original, premium storytelling, not an exact copy of existing channels.What We Offer:Salary: $450 - $500 USD per month (The final rate within this range will be agreed upon based on your visual quality, professionalism, and speed. Non-negotiable beyond $500).Stable and consistent daily workload.Clear communication and a respectful working environment.To Apply, Please Provide:A link to your portfolio or samples of your best movie recap / narrative edits.What editing software and specific plugins/tools do you use to achieve that hyper-sharp look and manage your workflow?Confirm your availability to handle 3 videos a day from Monday to Saturday, and your commitment to strict deadlines.

title: Content Creator + Editor (Philippines, Long-Term)
description: 26 Characters is a Chicago based content agency, and we are hiring one Content Writer and Editor to work from home in the Philippines. Here is the honest version of the job. We make boutique recruiting firm owners and corporate executives sound like the sharpest people in their industries on LinkedIn. We interview them, we build a brand that captures their positioning and their beliefs, we build a voice profile that captures how they actually talk, and then we produce their content month after month in their voice. This is an AI first role, so let us be direct about what that means. You are not expected to draft everything from scratch. You are expected to be genuinely expert with generative tools like Claude and ChatGPT, and to have the editorial judgment to know when what comes back is good, when it is generic, and exactly what to do about it. Beginners will not work here. If your experience is typing a prompt and pasting the result, that is not the skill we are paying for. We want someone who prompts with real intent, who can tell within one sentence whether the voice is off, and who rewrites and elevates output until a client reads it and thinks that is exactly how I would have said it. The work itself is LinkedIn posts, blog posts and long form articles between eight hundred and two thousand words, multi section newsletters, and editing drafts to a publishable standard. You will never start from a blank page. You will start from an interview transcript, a brand, and a voice profile, and your job is to mine them for the real stories, direct the tools well, and turn the output into finished work. Deadlines are fixed. You will work alongside a marketing manager, a content producer, and a video editor, but the written word is your lane and you own it end to end. title: Commercial Editor
description:
We are a commercial video and photography company based in Charlotte, North Carolina.



This is a long post for a high paying per video basis. Please read it all.



We create high-end visual content for national brands, luxury apartment communities, real estate developers, corporate clients, and major events. Our work includes lifestyle campaigns, website films, architectural videos, brand stories, interviews, commercials, and social media content.



We already have a successful remote editing workflow and are now looking for an experienced freelance editor to work on our larger commercial video projects.



This is a project-based position, not a full-time position.



We are looking for someone we can begin with on individual projects and continue giving consistent work to when the quality, communication, and turnaround are strong.



-The Role



You will edit lifestyle videos, website films, brand campaigns, architectural property videos, interviews, and other commercial projects.



Most standard projects will be approximately 60 seconds to 2 minutes long, although certain projects may be longer or more complex.



You will generally receive organized footage, a creative brief, brand information, music direction, and examples of the intended style.



We need someone who can take professionally captured footage and turn it into a polished, cinematic commercial video that feels intentional from beginning to end.



The right person understands that a premium commercial edit is more than placing attractive clips over music.



Shot selection, pacing, storytelling, music editing, sound design, color, transitions, and small details all matter.



-Responsibilities



• Edit polished lifestyle, real estate, architectural, corporate, and commercial videos



• Review and organize professionally captured footage



• Select the strongest shots rather than simply using every clip provided



• Build a clear visual story with strong pacing and emotional progression



• Edit music intentionally to support the story and visual rhythm



• Add tasteful sound design that improves the video without becoming distracting



• Edit interviews and dialogue when required



• Perform professional color correction and color grading



• Match footage captured on multiple professional cinema cameras



• Create clean titles, logos, and simple motion graphics when needed



• Follow client brand standards and project-specific creative direction



• Manage revisions carefully and complete every requested change



• Deliver organized project files and final exports on schedule



• Communicate clearly regarding availability and turnaround time



-The Type of Work We Produce



Our videos often feature:



• Luxury apartment communities and real estate developments



• Professional lifestyle models



• Restaurants, coffee shops, neighborhoods, and local businesses



• Architecture, interiors, amenities, and exterior spaces



• Corporate interviews and recruiting content



• Branded campaigns and website videos



• Event films and commercial recaps



Our style is premium, cinematic, natural, and modern.



We are not looking for aggressive social media effects, excessive transitions, random speed ramps, or templates that make every project look the same.



The editing should support the footage rather than overpower it.



-Required Experience



• A strong portfolio of professional commercial or cinematic video work



• Advanced experience with Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve



• Strong understanding of pacing, visual storytelling, music, and sound design



• Professional color correction and grading ability



• Experience working with LOG footage and multiple camera formats



• Strong attention to detail



• Reliable internet and a computer capable of handling professional 4K and 6K footage through proxy workflows



• Ability to follow detailed feedback without repeatedly missing revisions



• Good written English and dependable communication



• Ability to meet agreed deadlines



-Preferred Experience



The following experience is valuable but not required:



• Luxury real estate or multifamily property videos



• Hospitality, travel, fashion, or lifestyle campaigns



• Commercial brand films



• Architectural video editing



• Corporate interviews



• Motion graphics using After Effects



• DaVinci Resolve color grading



• Experience collaborating with American production companies or agencies



-This Position Is Not a Fit If



• Most of your experience is limited to basic Reels, TikToks, podcasts, or talking-head videos



• You rely heavily on templates, presets, or automated editing



• You add transitions and effects simply because they look interesting



• You need every shot and creative decision selected for you



• You frequently miss small revision notes



• You apply without carefully reading the complete posting



We care more about your portfolio and creative judgment than your degree, certifications, or number of years working.



-Project Rates



This is a freelance, project-based position.



Most standard lifestyle and website videos will pay between $250 and $400 USD per completed project, depending on the length, complexity, footage volume, turnaround requirements, and level of creative involvement.



More complex projects involving interviews, longer runtimes, advanced sound design, motion graphics, or additional deliverables will be priced separately before work begins.



A standard project will generally include:



• One primary video approximately 60 seconds to 2 minutes long



• Professionally captured and organized footage



• Creative direction and reference examples



• Shot selection and full edit



• Music editing and sound design



• Color correction and grading



• Basic titles or logo placement



• Two reasonable rounds of revisions



Additional versions, major creative changes, extensive motion graphics, or work outside the original scope will be discussed and approved separately.



Editors who consistently produce strong work, communicate well, and meet deadlines will receive priority for future projects. We regularly produce commercial content and are looking to build a long-term relationship with the right person.



-Paid Editing Test



Final candidates may be invited to complete a paid editing test using footage supplied by RedefineU Media.



The paid test rate will be between $100 and $150 USD, depending on the requested deliverable.



The test will evaluate:



• Shot selection



• Storytelling



• Pacing



• Music editing



• Sound design



• Color



• Attention to detail



• Ability to follow creative direction



The test footage and completed edit may not be shared, posted, or used in a public portfolio without written permission.



-How to Apply



Please include all of the following:



1. A short introduction explaining your commercial editing experience



2. A link to your portfolio or reel



3. Links to the three projects that best represent the quality of work you would deliver for us



4. A brief explanation of what you personally completed on each project



5. Your primary editing software



6. Your computer specifications and internet speed



7. Your typical turnaround time for a 60 to 120-second commercial video



8. Your current availability



9. Your requested project rate



10. The phrase “Planned Like Architecture” at the beginning of your application so we know you read the complete posting



Please do not send a general portfolio containing dozens of unrelated videos.



Show us your best commercial, lifestyle, hospitality, real estate, architectural, or brand work.



We are looking for someone who wants an ongoing freelance relationship and takes pride in producing excellent work.

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
Development Counsellors International is seeking to hire a virtual administrative support to assist in creating media reports in Microsoft Word and Excel.

s), the ability to follow step-by-step directions, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects and deadlines. It’s very important to have reliable internet service.

The outline of the scope of work is provided below. 

 

Daily, Add to Media Result Reports (2 hours per day) 

A media results report in PR is a document that analyzes and summarizes a company's media coverage over a specific period, showing the impact of PR efforts on organizational goals. It provides both quantitative data, like impressions and mentions, and qualitative insights, such as sentiment and message pull-through, to demonstrate the value of the PR campaign to stakeholders



Using a template: 

• Follow hyperlink to media placement and screen grab placement in accordance to the specs provided in the template. 

• Paste hyperlink into an Excel (each category will be outlined). 

• Using an online database, look up media outlet data and input outlet details into Excel. 

• Upon review, transfer data to Google Data Studio 

 

Create Media Success Stories (10 minutes each, up to 1 hour per day) 

A media success story in PR is achieved when a brand secures positive and influential coverage in media outlets that reaches a targeted audience, enhancing its visibility and reputation. 

Using a template: 

• Follow hyperlink to media placement fill in the details of the template using information from a media database to document the media outlet name, publication date, media profile, and reach.  

• Provide the resulting paragraph to account team to add details related to the origin of the media coverage prior to distribution. 

 

Create Briefing Books (up to 3 hours per project)  

A briefing book is an internal document that provides a spokesperson with all the information they need to prepare for a media interview or other public-facing engagement. It includes background on the reporter, company talking points, potential questions and answers, and key company information.

Following a template: 

• Cut and paste provided information from a staffer
 or online database into a Microsoft Word document 

• Use Google to add logos of media outlet 

• Use Google or LinkedIn to add photo of journalist 

• Format logos and photos to fit template format using the tools on Microsoft Word 

• Ensure formatting is 100?curate when compared to the template before returning document 

• Following Instructions: This job requires carefully following step-by-step directions. Can you give an example of a time when you successfully followed detailed instructions?

• Time Management: You will have multiple tasks to complete each day. How do you d
 which task to do first when you have many things to complete? 

• Technology Skills: This job requires using Excel, Microsoft Word, and Google tools. Can you describe your experience using these programs? 

• Handling Challenges: If you don’t understand a task or an instruction, what steps would you take to solve the problem? 

• Handling Repetitive Tasks: Some tasks in this role are repetitive but require accuracy. How do you stay focused and ensure quality in repetitive work? 

Key Qualifications / Skills:

• Effective communicator who can work independently with minimal supervision

• Meets deadlines and is dependable

• Strong attention to detail and ability to check work for accuracy

• Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and Google tools

• Ability to follow detailed instructions carefully

• Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively

This role is primarily responsible for compiling information, updating tracking documents, preparing materials using existing templates, and ensuring accuracy across reports and briefing documents.  

? 

Candidates must have a firm understanding of written English (to understand directions and respond to
s), ability to follow step-by-step directions, exceptional attention to detail, ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.?This job requires using Excel, Microsoft Word, and Google tools. 



Prior experience supporting public relations, communications, marketing or administrative teams is helpful but not required.

Daily Tasks (estimated 8 hours a week) 



Google Alerts Monitoring 



Set up Google Alerts based on a pre-assigned list of names, terms and topics 



Compile relevant coverage and links into a single summary
 



Send completed summaries to designated tea
mbers 



 

Secondary Media Pickup Tracking 

Secondary coverage is when an original news article is republished on a different news site or used to develop new, but related stories. Tracking secondary coverage allows us to see the larger impact or audience reach of a story.  



Monitor a designated list of articles and search for additional media pickup and/or republication on another website.   



Update a tracking spreadsheet with required information, including:  



Article URL 



Publication name 



Publication date 



Website traffic data (UVM) from Muck Rack 



Additional fields specified by the team 



Verify all data is accurate and formatted correctly before submission

These tasks are due on a quarterly basis; however, the work may be spread throughout the quarter leading up to the deadline. Therefore, we estimate one hour a week to complete the tasks by the deadline.  



Update comprehensive list of story coverage 



Every quarter, update an excel sheet with all the story coverage secured by the team in the past three months. A list of new coverage (and related information) will be shared with you. It may require reorganization to match the layout and organization of the comprehensive coverage excel sheet.

Editorial Calendar

Media Coverage PDFs

Convert media coverage into PDF format 



Save and organize files according to established naming conventions

title: Google Ads Strategist - Home Services (EST, Full Time)
description:
If you cannot commit to working EST hours, do not apply. THIS IS NOT AN ENTRY ROLE.



Sustain Media is a local SEO and Google Ads agency built only for home service businesses. Roofers,

plumbers, HVAC companies, electricians, landscapers, restoration companies, and auto shops. Most of

our clients are owner-operated businesses doing $2M to $10M a year. Our job is simple: more calls and

more booked jobs. Ultimately, every metric has to connect back to qualified leads, booked work, and

profitable growth.



We're hiring a Google Ads Strategist to join our paid media team.



What makes this role different



We use AI agents to handle a growing share of the repetitive work most agencies still do by hand,

including search term mining, campaign audits, performance diagnostics, and reporting data pulls. The

systems get better every month.



Right now, this role includes real implementation work. You'll build campaigns, write ads, make bid

changes, and manage accounts directly. We're moving quickly on AI systems, and over the next few

quarters the role should become increasingly focused on strategy rather than implementation.



That strategy includes understanding why a plumber in Portland needs a different structure than an

HVAC company in Fort Wayne, when to push budget into a seasonal spike, when to pull back, and how

to turn performance data into a growth plan for every account you run.



If you want the strategy-only version of this job on day one, this is not it. If you want to grow into it as the

systems mature, keep reading.



What you'll own



Your own book of clients. You'll own your accounts end to end, working alongside another PPC

specialist who manages a separate portfolio. You'll manage Google Ads across home service accounts

with different trades, markets, budgets, and growth goals. Each account needs its own strategy.



Lead generation. These campaigns exist to drive phone calls, form fills, and booked jobs. You need to

know how to build for that and measure it the way a business owner does: qualified lead volume,

acquisition cost, booked work, and return on spend, not clicks and impressions alone.



Tracking and attribution. A dashboard saying Google is working means nothing if the client's phone is

not ringing. You'll own conversion tracking on every account and know how to verify which campaigns

drive real calls, form fills, and booked jobs.



New account builds. When a client signs, you architect the account from zero, including keyword

research, campaign structure, ad copy, bidding, geo-targeting, conversion tracking, and launch.



Judgment calls. Our AI agent Viktor provides audits and diagnostics. You d
 what to do with them:

which bid strategy fits an account with 20 conversions a month versus 100, when PMax is supporting the

account, when it is obscuring poor lead quality or wasting spend, and when to restructure instead of

continuing to optimize around a flawed setup.



Landing pages and offers. You work with our development and SEO teams so ad traffic lands on pages

that convert. You guide the messaging and structure, but you do not build the pages.

Monthly reporting. Viktor pulls the data. You write the story, explain what changed, and lay out the plan

for the next month.



What success looks like



In your first 90 days, you'll take full ownership of a portfolio, confirm that tracking is trustworthy, identify

the largest performance opportunities, and establish a clear strategy for each account. Longer term,

success means improving qualified lead volume and booked-job economics while keeping clients

confident in the direction of their campaigns.



What we're looking for



Must-haves:

- Proven results running lead generation campaigns for local home service businesses

- Hands-on experience with Search, Performance Max, and Local Service Ads

- A strong understanding of conversion tracking. When a client says the leads are not coming in, 'the

dashboard looks fine' is not an answer. You know how to verify what is real.

- The ability to build an account from zero and defend every major choice you made

- The ability to read data and make strategic recommendations, not just report what a dashboard says

- Strong communication skills. You'll be in Slack daily.

Strong pluses:

- Strong attribution skills, including tracing ad spend through call tracking and offline conversions to

booked jobs

- Experience with CallRail or similar call-tracking platforms

- An understanding of how Google Business Profile and local SEO work together with paid search

- Agency experience managing multiple accounts at once

- Comfort working with AI tools. You do not need to build automations, but you should want to use

them.

The environment

- Remote, international team

- Contractor position, paid biweekly

- Base range: $1,500 to $2,000 USD per month depending on experience

- Revenue share: after a certain amount of time with a client, you will begin earning an ongoing

monthly share tied to how long that client stays with us. Realistically, this adds $200 to $500 per

month within your first year and keeps growing as your book matures. It is paid every month, for as

long as the client stays.



Daily tools: Google Ads, CallRail, Slack, Airtable, Google Sheets, and Viktor



You can work from anywhere in the world, but you work U.S. Eastern Time (EST) business hours.

This is a firm rule, not a preference. There is no time tracking, and there never will be, but the EST

schedule is non-negotiable. If you cannot commit to working EST hours, do not apply.



Our clients are month to month with no long-term contracts. We earn the business every 30 days,

which means the work has to be good.



Small senior team. You work directly with the founder and the operations team

title: Male E-commerce Operations Specialist – Long-Term Remote Role
description:
We are looking for a full-time E-commerce Operations Specialist to take responsibility for a broad set of recurring and occasional operational processes.



Working arrangement

• Full-time, long-term remote role

• 40 working hours per week

• At least 5 regular working hours overlapping with 10:00–18:00 Sofia (Bulgaria) time

• The work cannot be performed at the same time as another job or client engagement

• You need a reliable, quiet and sufficiently private workspace suitable for occasional calls

• Clear written English is required; perfect English is not



You may be a strong fit for this role if you are the kind of person who wants to understand how a process works – not only complete its steps. You notice when information is missing, question results that do not make sense, follow up without repeated reminders, and look for practical ways to make recurring work more reliable.



Direct experience with every platform or responsibility listed below is not required. We care more about reliability, attention to detail, sound judgment, clear communication and the ability to learn. Relevant e-commerce or operations experience is useful, but it is not a substitute for these qualities.



We are a small but growing e-commerce team operating several brands and selling across multiple international markets. Because the team is small, good work is visible and the right person can gradually take on more ownership, improve how the company operates and grow their compensation as their responsibilities expand.



Several members of our team are based in the Philippines and have worked with us full-time for an extended period. They have told us that this is the best company they have worked for, which we believe reflects the respectful, supportive and stable working environment we try to create.



Your work will include a mix of recurring process-based tasks and occasional situations that require investigation and judgment. You will receive training and access to detailed operating procedures. We do not expect you to know all our systems immediately, but we do expect you to understand the processes as you learn them, ask focused questions and gradually require less supervision.



When useful for the role, we are open to providing relevant training and educational resources.



The work will include several main areas:



Orders, suppliers and shipments

• Keep order and shipment tracking spreadsheets updated

• Follow production, inspection, dispatch, transit and delivery status

• Follow up with suppliers, inspectors, forwarders and warehouses

• Identify delays, missing information and discrepancies



Inventory and operational monitoring

• Update inventory and forecast spreadsheets

• Track stock across warehouse platforms, manufacturing and transit

• Monitor stock coverage and notice potential replenishment risks



Quality control and detailed checking

• Organize product inspections

• Review inspection photos, videos and reports



E-commerce operations and administration

• Handle recurring operational tasks

• Update operational reports and keep records organized



You are likely to succeed here if you:

• Are reliable and consistent without needing repeated reminders

• Pay close attention to details, especially when similar products, quantities, dates and markets are involved

• Want to understand why a process exists

• Notice missing information, contradictions and risks

• Use judgment when instructions do not perfectly fit the situation

• Communicate clearly and raise problems early

• Suggest practical improvements



Previous experience in e-commerce, Amazon, Shopify, spreadsheets, inventory tracking, logistics, supplier coordination, customer operations or automation will be useful. 

However, experience in any of these areas is not strictly required. We are primarily selecting for the qualities above and your ability to learn.



Compensation will depend on relevant experience and demonstrated capability. There is room for increases as you become more independent and take ownership of higher-value responsibilities. Candidates with strong, proven inventory management or forecasting experience may be considered for a higher starting salary and broader initial responsibilities.



The first step is a short application questionnaire. 

Shortlisted applicants will be invited to live conversations and may complete job-relevant tests. The rules regarding AI and other tools will be stated clearly for each stage.



Important: 

Please complete the application form without generative AI assistance. Do not use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot or another generative AI system to draft, translate, rewrite or improve any free-text response. Basic spelling correction is permitted, and you may look up the meaning of an unfamiliar word. Perfect English is not required; clear, specific and honest answers are more valuable than polished corporate language.



Please submit your application through OnlineJobs.ph and complete the application form here: 
  

We review candidates through the form so that everyone is evaluated consistently. No cover letter is required; the questionnaire replaces it. 



Thank you for taking the time to apply carefully. We will review complete applications and contact shortlisted candidates for the next step.

title: Senior TikTok Shop Commercial Manager – UK & Europe
description:
Location: Philippines, remote

Salary: ?100,000–?150,000 per month, depending on experience

Reporting to: UK Commercial Leadership Team

Employment type: Full-time





About Trojan



Trojan is a UK-based e-commerce, marketplace and fulfilment business that manages online stores and marketplace operations for major international brands.



We currently manage TikTok Shop activity for leading FMCG and consumer brands in the UK and have recently secured a major contract to manage TikTok Shop operations in the Netherlands, Italy and Belgium.



We are now looking for a senior, commercially focused TikTok Shop professional to take ownership of our growing TikTok Shop portfolio across the UK and Europe.







The Role



The Senior TikTok Shop Commercial Manager will be responsible for the commercial performance and growth of multiple branded TikTok Shops.



This is not primarily a content-creation, livestream-hosting or administrative Seller Centre role.



The successful candidate will act as the commercial owner of each TikTok Shop account, working directly with TikTok, our brand clients, affiliates, creators and Trojan’s operational teams.



The role requires someone who can understand performance data, identify commercial opportunities, develop clear growth plans and confidently present recommendations to major international brands.







Key Responsibilities



Commercial Management



- Own the commercial performance of multiple TikTok Shops across the UK, Italy, Netherlands and Belgium.

- Develop clear growth plans for each brand and market.

- Take responsibility for GMV, net sales, gross margin, promotional investment and advertising performance.

- Identify opportunities to increase sales through assortment, pricing, bundles, promotions, vouchers, samples and campaigns.

- Balance revenue growth with profitability and brand objectives.

- Review product performance and identify opportunities to expand or rationalise the range.





TikTok Relationship Management



- Manage the day-to-day commercial relationship with TikTok account managers and category teams.

- Represent Trojan and its clients in meetings with TikTok.

- Understand TikTok campaigns, platform initiatives, promotional mechanics and emerging opportunities.

- Ensure brands are participating in the most commercially relevant TikTok campaigns.

- Escalate and resolve account, policy or platform issues when required.





Client Management



- Build strong working relationships with major international brand clients. 

- Lead regular performance and planning meetings.

- Present clear analysis, recommendations and actions to senior client stakeholders.

- Translate TikTok terminology and platform activity into straightforward commercial implications.

- Challenge clients constructively when pricing, stock, content or promotional decisions are limiting growth.

- Ensure agreed actions are recorded, owned and completed.





Affiliate and Creator Commerce



- Develop the affiliate and creator strategy for each TikTok Shop.

- Identify suitable creators and affiliates for specific brands and products.

- Establish commission structures, product seeding and sample strategies.

- Measure creator and affiliate performance based on sales, profitability and return on investment.

- Work with local language or market specialists where Dutch or Flemish support is required.

- Build scalable affiliate programmes rather than relying only on one-off creator activity.





Advertising and Campaigns



- Manage and optimise TikTok Shop advertising activity, including GMV Max and other relevant Shop Ads tools.

- Monitor advertising spend, return on advertising spend and incremental sales.

- Work with creative teams to ensure sufficient content is available to support commercial activity.

- Plan promotional calendars around TikTok campaigns, product launches and seasonal events.

- Evaluate the financial impact of discounts, vouchers, free shipping and affiliate commissions.





Reporting and Analysis



- Produce weekly and monthly commercial performance reports.

- Analyse traffic, conversion, average selling price, promotional performance, advertising return, affiliate sales and product-level performance.

- Provide conclusions, recommendations and actions rather than simply reporting data.

- Identify underperforming products, campaigns and creators.

- Monitor cancellations, refunds, returns, customer feedback and account health.

- Maintain commercial forecasts for sales, stock and campaign demand.





Stock and Operations



- Work closely with Trojan’s fulfilment and operational teams.

- Forecast stock requirements for campaigns, promotions and creator activity.

- Identify potential stock shortages before they restrict sales.

- Help manage the operational impact of viral products and sudden increases in demand.

- Ensure listings, pricing, inventory and fulfilment arrangements are aligned across each market.





Experience Required



Candidates should ideally have:



- At least four years of experience in e-commerce, marketplaces or social commerce.

- At least two years of direct TikTok Shop experience.

- Experience managing a TikTok Shop, marketplace account or portfolio with responsibility for sales growth.

- Strong knowledge of TikTok Seller Centre.

- Experience with TikTok affiliates, creators, campaigns, vouchers, promotions and Shop Ads.

- Experience managing Shopee, Lazada, Amazon or other marketplaces would be beneficial.

- Experience working with major consumer, beauty, personal-care or FMCG brands.

- Evidence of personally improving GMV, profitability, conversion or advertising performance.

- Experience presenting performance and recommendations to clients or senior stakeholders.

- Strong Excel, Google Sheets or business intelligence skills.

- Excellent spoken and written English.





Personal Profile



The successful candidate will be:



- Commercially minded and comfortable being accountable for results.

- Confident speaking with TikTok and senior brand stakeholders.

- Able to challenge assumptions and recommend a clear course of action.

- Analytical, but able to draw conclusions from data.

- Proactive and able to identify opportunities without waiting for instructions.

- Comfortable managing multiple brands and markets.

- Structured, organised and reliable.

- Familiar with the language, terminology and commercial mechanics of TikTok Shop.

- Comfortable working remotely with a UK-based leadership team.

- Able to provide appropriate overlap with UK and European business hours.





Candidates We Are Not Looking For



This role is unlikely to suit someone whose experience is mainly limited to:



- Uploading products or maintaining listings.

- Responding to customer messages.

- General virtual-assistant work.

- Creating or editing TikTok videos.

- Livestream hosting without commercial responsibility.

- Contacting affiliates without measuring their commercial performance.

- Producing reports without providing conclusions or recommendations.





Measures of Success



The successful candidate will be measured against:

 

- Growth in GMV and net sales.

- Gross margin and promotional profitability.

- Advertising return and incremental sales.

- Affiliate and creator-generated revenue.

- Improvement in conversion and product performance.

- Delivery of agreed client growth plans.

- Accuracy of sales and stock forecasts.

- Quality of client reporting and recommendations.

- Strength of relationships with TikTok and brand clients.

- Successful launch and growth of TikTok Shop activity in the Netherlands and Belgium.





For interested candidates, please make and include to your resume a cover letter consisting of the following details:



1. Details of the TikTok Shops or marketplace accounts you have personally managed.

2. The approximate GMV or sales value of those accounts.

3. A quantified example of how you improved sales, margin, conversion or advertising performance.

4. Details of your experience managing affiliates and creators.

5. Details of any major brands you have supported.

6. Your current salary

7. and what is your expected salary and notice period for this role.





Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a commercial case study and present a proposed growth plan for a TikTok Shop.



Candidates must have personally owned commercial performance, not just assisted with Seller Centre administration.

title: High-Performance Executive Assistant (U.S. Tax & Executive Operations)
description:
We are looking for a high-performance operator who understands numbers, financial data, and business operations and can work directly alongside a fast-moving, visionary leader.



This role is ideal for someone with a background in U.S. tax, accounting, bookkeeping, financial reporting, or business analysis who wants to move beyond traditional administrative work and become a strategic partner to executive leadership.



If you thrive in fast-paced environments, think analytically, and take ownership without waiting to be told what to do, keep reading.



Who We Are



DAP Brands is a community of high performers building businesses that create real impact.



Our leadership team moves quickly, thinks strategically, and expects people to solve problems—not simply complete tasks.



We value:



-Speed

-Accountability

-Precision

-Emotional maturity

-Ownership

-Loyalty to the mission (not ego)



What This Role Really Is



This role combines Executive Support, Financial Operations, Data Analysis, and Business Execution.



Your primary responsibility is to help leadership make better decisions by organizing financial and operational information into clear, actionable insights.



You'll support executive initiatives while ensuring critical business, accounting, and tax-related information is accurate, organized, and decision-ready.



You'll help:



-Organize and analyze financial, operational, and business data

-Prepare executive reports, dashboards, and KPI tracking

-Review accounting, bookkeeping, and U.S. tax-related reports for accuracy and completeness

-Assist leadership in monitoring financial performance and operational metrics

-Coordinate with accounting, finance, tax, and operations teams

-Protect your executive's time by managing priorities and follow-through

-Drive accountability across leadership initiatives

-Identify operational gaps and recommend process improvements

-Translate strategy into structured execution

-Solve problems before they become emergencies



You will work closely with executive leadership and have visibility into confidential financial and business information.



Professionalism, discretion, and sound judgment are essential.



Preferred Background



We're especially interested in candidates with experience in one or more of the following:



-U.S. Tax Preparation or Tax Operations

-Public Accounting

-Bookkeeping

-Accounting or Finance

-Financial Analysis

-Business Analytics

-Audit or Compliance

-Controller or Accounting Support

-Executive Assistant supporting Finance or Executive Leadership



Experience with tools such as QuickBooks, Excel/Google Sheets, financial reporting software, or tax software is highly preferred.



What This Role Is NOT



This role is not for someone who:



-Needs constant reassurance or supervision

-Struggles with direct feedback

-Prefers slow-moving corporate environments

-Gets overwhelmed by changing priorities

-Waits for instructions instead of solving problems

-Is uncomfortable working with numbers, financial data, or business systems

-Frequently changes jobs every year



We operate in a high-accountability environment where ownership matters.



What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)



Within your first 90 days, you will:



-Organize and improve financial and operational reporting

-Build dashboards and executive reports that improve decision-making

-Support leadership with accurate accounting and tax-related insights

-Improve reporting processes across departments

-Run executive meetings with clear agendas and follow-up

-Anticipate leadership needs before they arise

-Track priorities and hold teams accountable

-Bring solutions, not just problems

-Operate calmly and effectively under pressure



The Profile That Thrives Here



You likely:



-Have experience in accounting, bookkeeping, finance, U.S. tax, or business analysis

-Understand financial statements, reconciliations, reporting, and business metrics

-Have supported a founder, executive, or finance leader

-Have remained in at least one meaningful role for three or more years

-Enjoy building systems and improving operational processes

-Are highly organized and analytical

-Communicate clearly and professionally

-Maintain composure under pressure

-Think in terms of business outcomes, not just completing tasks



You are someone who:



-Spots financial or operational issues before others do

-Brings clarity where others see complexity

-Takes initiative without waiting to be asked

-Uses data to support better business decisions



Compensation & Growth



This role offers:



-Competitive compensation based on experience and performance

-Direct exposure to executive leadership and strategic decision-making

-The opportunity to influence business operations and financial processes

-Long-term career growth as DAP Brands continues to scale



At DAP Brands, we reward impact, ownership, and results, not simply tenure.



Final Note



This opportunity is for someone who wants to grow beyond a traditional Executive Assistant role and become a trusted business partner to executive leadership.



If you have a background in U.S. tax, accounting, bookkeeping, finance, or financial operations and enjoy solving problems, improving systems, and helping leaders execute at a high level, we'd love to hear from you.



If you're looking for a slow-paced, highly structured corporate environment, this probably isn't the right fit.



But if you're excited to work alongside leadership, make data-driven decisions, and help build something meaningful, apply through our careers page 
/careers and write "MAVERICK" before your name.

nts, and ensure no family experiences delays or gaps in care. Success in this role requires both strong personal accountability and a team-first mindset.

nt in their lives.

-Support families primarily through inbound phone calls, as well as text and
, with empathy, clarity, and professionalism.

- Collaborate with teammates to support the broader case load and maintain continuity of care.

- Assist with team coverage, escalations, and urgent case needs as volumes shift.

- Partner with internal teams and external vendors to keep cases moving efficiently.

- Maintain accurate documentation, update systems promptly, and proactively flag issues.

- Ensure smooth case handoffs and anticipate downstream impacts.

- Work across HubSpot, Aircall, Slack, GSuite, and our internal case management system.



Requirements & Qualifications:

- Clear, calm communicator who builds trust quickly, whether over the phone,
, or text.

- Strong multitasker - able to move quickly while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.

- Accountable and proactive: you take ownership, close the loop, and surface issues early.

- Energized by our mission and excited about the opportunity to help shape something new in a category that truly needs it.

- A home setup that supports the work - see our tech requirements for details.



Bonus Points

- Experience in environments where empathy and execution were equally important.

- Spanish fluency - many of the families we serve speak it.



Details:

- Remote, full-time

Shift: Full-time (consistent schedule)

Days:

- Monday–Friday

Why You’ll Love Working With Us:

- A serious employer for global teammates. We have years of experience running distributed teams. Same 1:1s, check-ins, and career paths as our U.S. team - same expectations, same opportunities.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Status: Remote Position



Company Overview:



At ACTIV, we are a forward-thinking ecommerce marketing agency dedicated to revolutionizing how brands connect with their audiences. Our mission is to craft compelling marketing campaigns that not only captivate but also convert. Our brands are some of the fastest growing brands in the DTC space in health and wellness. With creativity at our core, we strive to push the boundaries of ecommerce marketing, making an indelible impact on the industry.



Job Description:



We are seeking a highly skilled and innovative Graphic Designer to join our dynamic team for a full time role. This individual will play a crucial role in creating engaging and effective static image assets that resonate with our target audiences and drive purchases for ecommerce brands. The ideal candidate will have a blend of creative talent, technical expertise, and a deep understanding of ecommerce marketing and consumer psychology.



Qualifications:



- At least 2 years of experience in graphic design within ecommerce marketing or social media, with a strong portfolio showcasing your work.

- Demonstrated proficiency in design software such as Figma (preferred), Adobe Photoshop, and Canva.

- Solid understanding of consumer psychology and how visual hierarchy, typography, and layout influence purchasing decisions.

- Experience creating both native-style static images and polished designed assets for paid social advertising.

- A background in creative strategy is highly advantageous.

- Agency experience is a plus.

- Fluency in English is required.



Key Competencies:



- Strong creative and direct response skills, with the ability to produce content that engages and converts.

- Exceptional attention to detail, particularly in typography, layout, and organizing copy in a way that is easy to read and understand.

- Experience taking briefs from a creative strategist and developing high-quality image assets.

- A desire to continually learn, grow, and challenge the status quo in design and content creation.

- Ability to utilize AI tools in the design process, including AI-generated images, as well as learning new AI tools to expedite the ability to create more winning creative.

- Ability to follow and capitalize on emerging trends, creating unique and compelling static content.

- A strong desire to be creative and push the limits with new design concepts for our advertising campaigns.



Overview:



As part of the ACTIV agency, you play a crucial role in shaping the visual storytelling and narrative of our ecommerce clients. Your expertise in graphic design will be instrumental in creating compelling content that not only reflects the essence of each brand but also drives new customer acquisition at scale. Given the remote nature of your role, we value independence, communication, and the ability to manage time effectively across different time zones.



Roles and Responsibilities:



- Graphic Design: You will be responsible for creating polished static image content for Meta & TikTok. This involves designing native-style images that blend seamlessly into social feeds, as well as more polished designed assets. Your work must be visually compelling, easy to read, and effective at stopping the scroll and driving clicks.

- Collaboration:Regularly collaborate with the creative team, including directors, content creators, and video editors, to align on the creative vision and ensure that the final products meet or exceed client expectations. Communication will primarily be via digital platforms, including Slack, and once a week video calls via Slack.

- Creative Input: Contribute ideas and suggestions to improve content quality during brainstorming sessions and creative meetings. Your input on the creative direction, visual style, and design approach is highly valued.

- Project Management: Manage your design projects from conception to delivery, ensuring that all content is completed within the agreed timelines and adheres to the client's brand guidelines. This includes prioritizing tasks, setting milestones, and keeping stakeholders informed of progress.

- Quality Control: Ensure all images meet ACTIV's quality standards and are optimized for viewing on Meta & TikTok.

- Technical Proficiency: Maintain an up-to-date knowledge of design software and technologies, suggesting upgrades or new tools as necessary to keep our content cutting-edge. ACTIV can and will provide you with additional software access when needed and necessary to do your job better.

-Flexibility and Adaptability: Given your remote location and the flexible working hours, adaptability to the needs of the team and projects across time zones is essential. You must be willing to adjust your working hours when needed to meet critical deadlines or collaborate with the team.



Working Hours:



- This position offers flexible working hours to accommodate the difference in time zones between Eastern Standard Time (New York, USA) and your time zone. We expect a reasonable overlap with the team's working hours for meetings and collaborative sessions but will work together to establish a schedule that suits everyone.



Expectations:



- Maintain open and consistent communication with your team and direct report.

- Deliver high-quality image content within specified deadlines.

- Be proactive in addressing challenges or delays that may impact project timelines.



Tools and Software:

title: B2B Cold Email Specialist - Show Me Your Reply Rates (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
START YOUR APPLICATION WITH THE WORDS "PRIMARY INBOX" OR IT WILL BE DELETED WITHOUT READING.



We run two B2B companies - one in the advertising industry, one in lead generation - and we're hiring ONE person to own
 for both. Not "help with
." OWN it. Cold outbound, warm nurture, newsletters, deliverability - the whole machine, end to end.



Here's the interesting part: we have NO
 stack yet. No sequencer, no lists, no sending domains. You'll recommend the tools, set up the infrastructure, build the lists, write the copy, and run the campaigns. If reading that excites you, keep going. If it scares you, this isn't your role.



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO



- Set up cold
 infrastructure from zero: secondary domains, mailboxes, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, warmup, volume ramps

- Pick and run our stack (Instantly, Smartlead, Lemlist - you tell US what's best and why)

- Build targeted B2B lists: Apollo, Sales Nav, scraping - then VERIFY them, because bounce rates kill domains

- Segment by ICP and personalize at scale

- Write cold sequences that get replies from busy people who get 200
s a day

- Handle warm
 too: nurture sequences, newsletters, broadcasts for our existing leads

- Monitor deliverability like a hawk - placement tests, bounce rates, spam complaints, blacklists

- A/B test subject lines, angles, offers - and report on what matters: replies, positive replies, meetings booked

- Own the numbers. You'll report reply rates weekly, and you'll know WHY they moved.



WHO WE WANT



Someone who has personally run cold
 campaigns end to end and can prove it with numbers. Not someone who "assisted the
 team." Not someone whose experience is Mailchimp newsletters to an opt-in list. Someone who has taken a fresh domain, warmed it up, built a list, written the copy, hit send, and booked meetings - and can tell us the exact reply rates they got.



You think in positive replies and meetings booked, not open rates (you know why open rates lie now). You know what the 2024 Google/Yahoo sender requirements changed. You have opinions about tools. You've killed a domain at least once and you know exactly what you did wrong.



YOU MUST HAVE



- Real B2B cold
 campaign experience with numbers you can defend

- Deliverability fundamentals: SPF/DKIM/DMARC, warmup, ramp schedules - deep enough to troubleshoot

- List building + verification skills (Apollo, Sales Nav, scraping, verifiers)

- Strong natural English copywriting - your
s must sound human

- Self-direction: we give you the target market, you build the machine



BONUS POINTS



- You've sold TO agencies, media buyers, advertisers, or SaaS companies

- Clay, AI personalization, spintax done tastefully

- ESP experience (Brevo, ActiveCampaign, Klaviyo) for the warm side

- Placement testing tools (GlockApps, MailReach)

- Basic automation (Make, Zapier, Apify, scripts)



THE DEAL



$500/mo to start, full-time, fully remote, async-first (chat, not meetings). We're direct: this is proving-ground pay. But we promote fast and pay for results - if your campaigns book meetings, your salary follows. You work directly with the owner, no middle management, and you get full ownership of a channel most companies fragment across three people.



HOW TO APPLY



Start with "PRIMARY INBOX", then answer ALL of these. Short, real, specific answers beat long polished ones. If your application reads like AI slop, remember: your job is writing
s people WANT to answer - prove it here.



1. Describe the best cold
 campaign you personally ran: ICP, list size, tools, total sends, reply rate, positive reply rate, meetings/deals booked. Real numbers - I'll ask follow-ups.

2. Walk me through going from a brand-new domain to the first 1,000 cold
s sent - every step, in order.

3. Your reply rate drops from 5% to under 1% overnight mid-campaign. What do you check, and in what order?

4. How would you build a verified list of 500 US marketing agency owners? Exact tools and steps. What bounce rate is acceptable to you?

5. Paste one cold
 you wrote that actually got replies (mask client names if needed). Why did it work?

6. We have NO stack. What sequencer, verification tool, and ESP would you set up for us, why, and at what rough monthly cost?

7. What's your warm
 experience - nurture sequences, newsletters? Which ESPs, what results?

8. Rate yourself 1-10 (honest - I verify): deliverability/infrastructure, list building, cold copywriting, sequencer tools, ESP/nurture, analytics & A/B testing.

9. What did you learn about deliverability or cold outreach in the last 30 days?

10. When can you start? Full-time available?

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We don't care about your certificates. We don't care how many years your resume claims. We've met 
 marketing managers" with 8 years of experience who have never warmed up a domain, and self-taught freelancers who can take a cold list to booked meetings in two weeks.



We care about exactly one thing: can you take two B2B companies with ZERO
 infrastructure and turn cold inboxes into a predictable stream of replies and meetings - without anyone holding your hand?



You're probably the person who:

- Has personally sent tens of thousands of cold
s and knows their reply rates by heart

- Gets a little too excited explaining why open rates are a lie since Mail Privacy Protection

- Has strong opinions about Instantly vs Smartlead and can defend them

- Killed a sending domain once, did the post-mortem, and never made that mistake again

- Reads deliverability news the way normal people read sports scores



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO



Own
 for two companies - one in advertising, one in lead gen. Cold outbound is the core: infrastructure from zero (domains, mailboxes, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, warmup), list building with real verification discipline, segmentation, copy that sounds human, sending, and relentless optimization on replies and meetings. Plus the warm side: nurture sequences and newsletters. You pick the entire stack - we're deliberately starting from nothing so the right person builds it their way.



WHAT YOU GET



- $500 USD/month (about PHP 29,000) full-time to start - with raises tied to one thing: meetings your campaigns book. Prove it and the number moves fast.

- Every tool you need, paid for - you choose them

- Direct line to the owner, async communication, zero pointless meetings

- Total ownership of a channel. Your numbers, your machine, your credit.



HOW TO APPLY



0. THE REAL TEST: You audit a client's DNS and see their SPF record ends in ~all. What does that mean, and when would you use -all instead? Two sentences max. (Wrong answer = we stop reading. This is day-one knowledge for this role.)

1. Start your application with the decoded word (capital letters, first line, nothing before it)

2. Your best cold campaign, with numbers: ICP, list size, sends, reply rate, positive replies, meetings booked. We follow up on these, so real beats impressive.

3. New domain to first 1,000 cold sends - every step, in order.

4. Reply rate crashes from 5% to 1% overnight. Your diagnostic checklist, in order.

5. Paste a cold
 you wrote that got replies. Why did it work?

6. We have no stack. Name the sequencer + verifier + ESP you'd set up, why, and rough monthly cost.

7. Honest 1-10 self-ratings (we verify): deliverability/infra, list building, cold copywriting, sequencer tools, ESP/nurture, A/B testing.

8. What did you learn about deliverability or outreach in the last 30 days?

9. When can you start? Full-time available?



Applications that skip the decoded word get deleted unread - not because we're cruel, but because attention to detail is 80% of deliverability.



If you read Question 0 and the answer was just... there, in your head, before you finished the sentence - apply now. This post was written for you.

title: Senior Web Developer, Full-Time Website Development
description:
We are looking for a dedicated full-time Senior Web Developer based in the Philippines to join our marketing team remotely. This is a long-term role for an experienced developer with at least 5 years of professional web development experience who can build, maintain, and improve modern, responsive, high-performing websites and web applications.



This person will support our ongoing website development and digital marketing needs. Projects may include building new website pages and landing pages, improving existing websites, developing custom features or applications, troubleshooting technical issues, connecting third-party platforms, improving site speed, supporting search engine optimization, and maintaining overall website performance and security.



Strong experience with WordPress, Elementor, and Webflow is preferred. You should also be comfortable working directly with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and other technologies needed to develop or customize professional websites.



Experience building custom web applications or working across both front-end and back-end development is strongly preferred. This may include experience with frameworks such as React, Next.js, Vue, Angular, Node.js, Laravel, or similar technologies. You should also be comfortable working with databases, APIs, authentication systems, hosting environments, and third-party platform integrations.



You should be able to take a design, mockup, wireframe, or project brief and turn it into a polished, functional webpage or application that closely matches the intended design. Strong attention to layout, typography, spacing, mobile responsiveness, and consistency is essential.



Responsibilities may include:

• Building and updating WordPress and Webflow websites

• Creating landing pages and website sections from approved designs

• Customizing Elementor templates, components, and functionality

• Writing and editing HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP

• Developing custom WordPress features when required

• Building or supporting custom web applications

• Contributing to both front-end and back-end development

• Creating and maintaining APIs and third-party integrations

• Working with databases, user authentication, and application logic

• Ensuring websites and applications work properly across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices

• Troubleshooting layout, functionality, plugin, theme, and compatibility issues

• Improving page speed, Core Web Vitals, and overall site performance

• Supporting technical and on-page SEO requirements

• Connecting forms, CRM platforms, analytics tools, advertising pixels, APIs, and other third-party systems

• Managing redirects, tracking codes, cookies, and website integrations

• Performing website maintenance, updates, backups, and quality checks

• Identifying and resolving security or performance concerns

• Testing all work carefully before publishing

• Documenting custom code, integrations, and important development processes



The ideal candidate understands both development and the practical needs of a marketing team. You should be able to build websites and applications that look professional, load quickly, work correctly, and support lead generation, customer experience, and business goals.



Strong experience with the following is preferred:

• WordPress

• Elementor

• Webflow

• HTML5

• CSS3

• JavaScript

• PHP

• Responsive web development

• Front-end development

• Back-end development

• Custom web application development

• APIs and third-party integrations

• Databases and application architecture

• Website performance optimization

• Core Web Vitals

• Technical SEO

• Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager

• Form and CRM integrations

• Git or another version-control system

• Website hosting, domains, DNS, SSL, backups, and staging environments

• Cross-browser and cross-device testing



Experience with React, Next.js, Vue, Angular, Node.js, Laravel, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Supabase, WooCommerce, Figma, Adobe applications, Odoo, or similar development and marketing platforms is a plus.



This is not an entry-level position. We are looking for a senior developer who can work independently, solve problems, make sound technical decisions, and consistently deliver reliable, polished work. You should know when you can resolve an issue independently and when you need to ask questions before moving forward.



Attention to detail is essential. All work must be tested for functionality, responsiveness, browser compatibility, performance, and accuracy before it is considered complete. You will also be expected to protect existing website functionality and avoid introducing unnecessary plugins, security risks, or technical debt.



Strong English communication, organization, reliability, responsiveness, and the ability to meet deadlines are required. You should be comfortable receiving feedback and working with marketing, graphic design, copywriting, sales, operations, and company leadership.



This is a full-time position for someone looking for consistent, long-term work with one company. We are not looking for an agency, development firm, or part-time freelancer. We are looking for an individual developer who can become a trusted member of our marketing team.



The use of artificial intelligence and coding-assistance tools is permitted when appropriate, but you will remain responsible for reviewing, testing, securing, and documenting all code and work you submit. We are not looking for someone who relies on AI-generated code without fully understanding how it works.



Please include the following in your application:

1. A short introduction about yourself and your web development experience

2. Confirmation that you have at least 5 years of professional web development experience

3. A link to your portfolio, GitHub profile, or examples of websites and applications you have developed

4. A description of your experience with WordPress, Elementor, and Webflow

5. Examples of landing pages, custom website features, integrations, or performance improvements you have completed

6. Details about any custom web applications or full-stack projects you have built

7. An explanation of your specific responsibilities on each featured project, including which parts you personally developed

8. The programming languages, frameworks, platforms, databases, development tools, and AI tools you are comfortable using

9. Details about your experience with responsive development, website performance, technical SEO, analytics, APIs, and third-party integrations

10. Your expected monthly salary in USD

11. Your availability and preferred working hours

12. Confirmation that you can work 40 hours per week and maintain at least four hours of daily overlap with our New York team



Please make sure your application and portfolio accurately represent your own skills and the quality of work you can personally produce.



We are located in New York, United States, and operate on Eastern Time. This position will be performed remotely from the Philippines. We require at least four hours of overlap with our team during our normal morning hours.



One possible schedule would be approximately 4:00 p.m. to 12:00 a.m. Philippine Time, which generally provides overlap with our team between 8:00 a.m. and 12:00 p.m. Eastern Time. Exact hours can be discussed, and occasional schedule adjustments may be needed when daylight saving time changes in the United States.



This role is required to use the TimeProof application to log and track all working hours. At the end of each work week, you will total the hours recorded in TimeProof and submit a PayPal invoice for the hours worked during that week.



We will add an additional 3.5% processing allowance to the invoice subtotal to offset the transaction fees collected by PayPal. Payments will be processed weekly after the submitted hours and invoice have been reviewed.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

YOU'RE A STRONG FIT IF



- You have 2+ years of hands-on experience managing both Meta Ads and Google Ads

- You've managed lead-generation campaigns and can speak to qualified leads, not just clicks or platform conversions

- You understand Meta Pixel, GA4, GTM, UTMs, conversion actions, and CRM attribution

- You can audit an inherited account before making changes

- You can explain what happened, why you think it happened, and what you would test next

- You write and speak clear English

- You take ownership, document your work, and ask sharp questions

- You already use AI in practical ways for research, creative analysis, reporting, or campaign planning



BONUS POINTS



- Home services, construction, roofing, education, or local lead generation

- GoHighLevel or another lead-management CRM

- Call tracking, YouTube Ads, or Performance Max

- Writing creative briefs or direct-response concepts

- Building useful AI workflows for ad research, reporting, or analysis



SCHEDULE



This is a full-time, 40-hour role. You'll need reliable daily overlap with a U.S. Eastern Time team. Include your available working hours in your application.



HOW TO APPLY



Use this subject line:



PAID MEDIA | [largest monthly ad spend you personally managed]



Include:



1. Your resume and OnlineJobs.ph profile

2. Your expected monthly salary in USD

3. Your earliest start date and current client or employment commitments

4. One Meta lead-generation campaign you personally managed, including the niche, monthly spend, CPL, how you measured lead quality, what you changed, and the result
