title: Marketing AI Engineer (Go-to-market Engineer)
description:
MARKETING AI ENGINEER

Official title: GTM Engineer (Go-to-Market Engineer)

Swerv Digital, Full-time, Remote (Philippines), Long-term





We are looking for someone who understands marketing AND builds with AI. Not a designer who uses AI tools. Not an engineer who has never seen a Meta Ads account. Someone who sits in the middle: knows why an ad works, and can build the system that produces a hundred of them.



The official title for this role is GTM Engineer, short for Go-to-Market Engineer. We describe it as Marketing AI Engineer because that is plainly what it is: marketing understanding plus AI engineering, in one person.



It is a build role. You will be constructing the machinery that takes our marketing to market, as Viktor and Frederik's right hand on systems development.



Please read the whole post before applying. We ask for something specific at the bottom, and applications that skip it are not considered.





=====================================

THE BASICS

=====================================



TYPE: Full-time, long-term. We are not hiring for a project.

LOCATION: Remote. You work from the Philippines.

SCHEDULE: Fully flexible. You d
 when you work.

SALARY: 1,000 USD per month to start, paid monthly.

GROWTH: Yearly salary re-evaluation plus yearly performance bonuses.

TOOLS: We pay for everything you need, including AI subscriptions, compute and software.

APPLY TO: 

TIMELINE: We are hiring within 1 to 2 weeks.





=====================================

READ THIS PART FIRST

=====================================



We hired for a creative role earlier this year. Great person, real talent. It did not work, and the reason is worth being honest about, because it defines this role.



The job involved a lot of prompting, a lot of systems thinking, and a lot of working THROUGH AI rather than with your hands. For someone whose satisfaction comes from craft, from making the thing themselves, that is draining. Not wrong, just a mismatch. We learned something about ourselves: we are not a creative studio that uses AI. We are an AI-operations company that produces marketing.



So this posting is not a re-run of that one. We are not looking for a creative who tolerates AI. We are looking for someone whose actual joy is in the system: building agents, wiring up pipelines, designing the prompt architecture, pushing volume through it, and watching output quality climb because you improved the machine.



If reading that made you lean in, this might be one of the most interesting jobs on this site. If it made you deflate slightly, save yourself the application, and we mean that kindly.





=====================================

HOW WE WORK: YOUR SCHEDULE, ZERO MICROMANAGEMENT

=====================================



You d
 when you work. Fully flexible.



We do not micromanage. Ever. There is no time tracker, no screenshot software, no check-in ritual to prove you were at your desk. We are a small, fast-moving team and that model only functions on trust in both directions.



What we care about is output, 
ntum and communication. Ship things. Tell us what you are working on. Flag problems early. Be reachable when it matters. Beyond that, structure your days however you actually work best, early mornings, late nights, whatever produces your best work.



This is a real advantage and also a real filter. Some people thrive with that much freedom and produce more than they ever did under supervision. Others need external structure to stay in motion, and quietly drift without it. If you are honest with yourself and you are the second type, this will not be a good year for either of us.



You should be the kind of person who gets EXCITED reading that paragraph, not nervous.





=====================================

ABOUT SWERV DIGITAL

=====================================



Swerv Digital is a performance marketing and e-commerce agency based in Aarhus, Denmark. Small, tight-knit team, Viktor, Frederik and RJ, and we are hiring for the long haul.



RJ, one of our core tea
mbers, is Filipino. Our team already works across time zones and cultures every day, and it works well. We are direct, open and collaborative. You will not be treated as an outsourced pair of hands. You will be a member of the team with real ownership and a real voice in what we build.



We work with ambitious e-commerce and service businesses across the Nordics and Europe, operating as an outsourced CMO and e-commerce manager rather than a traditional agency.



We are paid on performance. Our income is tied to what we actually move for clients. That is why efficiency is not a nice-to-have here. It is the business model.





WE ARE EXTREMELY HEAVY ON AI



We are in the top 1% of companies globally in how deeply AI is embedded in daily operations. Concretely, what already exists:



- An internal data and operations platform that our AI systems query directly

- 15+ live tool integrations: Shopify, Meta, Klaviyo, Google Ads, Notion, Slack, Ahrefs, Figma, Calendly, Drive and more, all callable by agents

- A structured knowledge system where brand, tone and compliance rules are encoded so AI produces on-brand, legally sound output at volume

- Automated performance loops: weekly pipelines that pull ad data, apply decision rules, produce kill/scale/hold recommendations, log winners, and generate the next round of creative concepts

- Internal tools we built ourselves, including a creative intelligence system that scrapes, transcribes and analyses competitor ads to extract what is actually working

- Agent chains, where one system's output becomes the next one's input, end to end, with a human reviewing rather than executing



You will inherit this and be expected to make it substantially better. There is a lot of low-hanging fruit and a lot of things we know are held together with tape.



You will also get access to tooling and resources most people simply cannot get on their own. That is part of the deal, and part of why we care more about your potential than your CV.





=====================================

THE ROLE

=====================================



You will be Viktor and Frederik's right hand on building systems.



That means building and improving agents, pipelines and tooling across the whole marketing stack: creative production at volume, ad copy generation with compliance built in, performance analysis and reporting, research and competitor intelligence, client communication drafts, internal documentation, and anything else currently costing us human hours that a well-built system could absorb.



It also means bringing ideas. We want someone who tests new approaches, reports back on what worked, argues for a better way, and pushes the company's limits rather than waiting to be pointed at something. You will be in the room where we d
 what to build next, and expected to have opinions there.



You need to be close to the actual marketing too. You should understand what a good Meta ad is, why a hook works, what creative fatigue looks like in the data, and how a funnel behaves, because you cannot build a system that produces good marketing if you cannot recognise good marketing.



Concrete examples of what you might do in your first months:



- Improve our creative production pipeline so a week of ad assets goes from a half-day of work to an hour

- Build an agent that monitors ad performance across all accounts and surfaces problems before we notice them

- Design an evaluation layer so we can actually measure whether a change to a prompt system made output better or worse

- Extend our internal platform so data, creative history and performance results live in one queryable place instead of three

- Automate the parts of reporting that are currently manual

- Build the internal interface that makes all of this usable by non-technical colleagues





=====================================

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

=====================================



BUILD AND IMPROVE INTERNAL AI SYSTEMS

Design, build, deploy and maintain the agents, pipelines and tools that run our operations. Own them end to end, including the unglamorous parts: error handling, monitoring, versioning, and making sure things still work in three months.



PROMPT AND CONTEXT ARCHITECTURE

Design the structured instruction systems that make AI output reliably good rather than occasionally good. Encoding brand voice, compliance rules, product data and decision logic so output stays consistent over time. This is a real engineering discipline and we treat it as one.



EVALUATION AND QUALITY

Build the measurement layer. If we cannot tell whether a change improved output, we are just guessing. Set up evals, comparisons, regression checks and quality gates.



INTEGRATIONS AND DATA PLUMBING

Connect our stack. APIs, webhooks, MCP servers, databases, automation platforms. Get data out of Meta, Shopify, Klaviyo, Google Ads and Notion and into places where it is useful. Make it reliable.



MARKETING SYSTEMS AT VOLUME

Build the machinery for high-volume creative and copy production, with brand and compliance constraints intact. Volume without quality control is worthless. Quality without volume does not scale. You own both sides.



PERFORMANCE ANALYSIS TOOLING

Turn ad and e-commerce data into automated analysis: performance loops, anomaly detection, cross-account learning, reporting. Help us see patterns no individual account manager would spot.



INTERNAL TOOLING AND INTERFACES

Build things the rest of the team can actually use. A brilliant system nobody but you can operate is a liability.



TEST AND PUSH THE LIMITS

Actively try new models, tools and approaches. Form a view on what is worth adopting and what is noise. Bring proposals to Viktor and Frederik rather than waiting for direction. We change how we work whenever something better appears, and we want you driving that.





=====================================

REQUIREMENTS

=====================================



YOU GENUINELY LOVE WORKING WITH AI

This is the single most important requirement. You use AI systems daily, you have built things with them, you have opinions about which models are good at what and why. When a new model or tool ships you have tried it before the newsletter about it lands. This is not enthusiasm for the IDEA of AI. It is a practical, hands-on habit.



YOU CAN BUILD

You write code. Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar. You can work with APIs, databases (SQL), automation platforms and modern AI tooling. You do not need a degree or years of enterprise experience, but you need to be able to ship working systems without someone holding the other end.



YOU UNDERSTAND MARKETING, OR WILL LEARN IT FAST

Specifically paid social, and specifically Meta. Hooks, ROAS, CPA, creative fatigue, the learning phase, why Advantage+ changed how campaigns get structured. If you already know this, great. If you do not yet but you are the kind of person who will have absorbed it within a month, say so and show us why we should believe you.



FLUENT ENGLISH, NON-NEGOTIABLE

You must be genuinely fluent in written and spoken English. Our entire team communicates in English, and this role in particular lives on precise writing, because you will be designing instructions for both humans and machines. You will be on video calls regularly. If we experience a language barrier in the process, it is not a match. We would rather be blunt about this now than waste your time later.



SYSTEMS THINKING

You naturally see processes rather than tasks. When you do something twice manually, it bothers you. You think in inputs, transformations, outputs and feedback loops.



SELF-DIRECTION

You get a problem and you run with it. You ask sharp questions up front, then deliver. You manage your own schedule and priorities without supervision, and you flag blockers early.



A STEEP LEARNING CURVE SOUNDS EXCITING, NOT SCARY

You want to be significantly better in six months than you are today, and you are willing to put in real effort to get there.



RELIABLE SETUP

Stable internet, a computer that can handle real development work, a quiet space for calls.



PRAGMATISM

We are a business, not a research lab. A scrappy thing that works and saves us ten hours a week beats an elegant thing that is 80% done. Know when to stop polishing.



LONG-TERM MINDSET

We are building a small, highly efficient team that works together for years. We want someone who will still be here, and much more senior, in three years.





=====================================

NICE TO HAVE

=====================================



- Agent frameworks and orchestration: MCP, tool-use patterns, multi-step agent design

- Shopify, Klaviyo or Meta API experience, the platforms we live in

- Data work: pipelines, warehousing, transformation, dashboarding

- Front-end skills: React or similar, for building internal interfaces

- Video or creative production understanding, how assets actually get made

- Having run your own thing: a side project, tool, product or business you built and shipped

- Agency experience: you understand what serving multiple clients at once feels like





=====================================

WHAT THIS JOB IS NOT

=====================================



To be as clear as possible, since we got this wrong once:



- It is NOT a graphic design or art direction role. You will not be asked to have great taste in typography.

- It is NOT a hands-on creative craft role. If your satisfaction comes from making the artifact yourself, you will not enjoy this.

- It is NOT a pure engineering role isolated from the business. You will be close to campaigns and revenue.

- It is NOT a role with a clear backlog handed to you. Ambiguity is the default state.

- It is NOT a virtual assistant or task-execution role. We need someone who d
 WHAT to build, not just builds what they are told.





=====================================

SALARY, GROWTH AND BONUS

=====================================



- 1,000 USD per month to start, paid monthly.

- Yearly salary re-evaluation, based on what you have taken on and delivered, not on how long you have been here.

- Yearly performance bonuses. We are a performance marketing agency. We get paid mostly on the results we deliver, and we think the team should work the same way. When the agency performs, everyone is rewarded.

- Real room to grow. This role has no ceiling we can see. The systems you build directly determine how much this company can handle, which means your leverage is enormous and visible.

- We invest in your development. Models, tools, compute, courses, experiments, we pay for them. The better you get, the better we all get.

- We pay on time. Every month. No chasing, no excuses.





=====================================

WHY JOIN SWERV DIGITAL

=====================================



Very few places will let you build AI systems that go straight into production against real money, with no committee, no procurement process and no six-month approval cycle. You will ship something on Tuesday and see it affect results by Friday.



You will not be one engineer among fifty maintaining someone else's platform. You will be Viktor and Frederik's right hand, the person who helps d
 what our operational machinery looks like, brings new approaches to the table, and gets to test them.



And you will be doing this at a company that has already committed, genuinely and structurally, not in a press release, to being AI-first. The foundation is built. We need someone to help make it formidable.





=====================================

HOW TO APPLY

=====================================



SEND YOUR APPLICATION TO: 



This is important. Applications sent anywhere else will not be considered.



Include the following:



1. A PERSONAL INTRODUCTION

Who are you as a person? What do you like? What drives you? What are you curious about right now? This matters more to us than anything else in your application, so do not rush it and do not make it generic.



2. YOUR PREVIOUS WORK

Give us an idea of your experience: projects, jobs, things you have built.



Important: a long track record is NOT necessary. What matters is a genuine will to prove yourself and appetite for a steep learning curve. Most people have never had access to the kind of resources and tooling we work with, and we know that. We are not filtering for people who already had the opportunity. We are looking for the person who will do the most with it once they have it.



3. SOMETHING YOU HAVE BUILT WITH AI

Any size. A system, agent, pipeline, tool, automation, prompt setup, anything you actually use or used. Tell us what problem it solved, what you tried that failed, and what you would do differently now. Scrappy is fine. Honest is better.



4. ONE THING YOU WOULD AUTOMATE

Think about a marketing agency producing ads for many brands at once. Pick one part of that work you would systematise or automate, and tell us roughly how you would build it. Keep it short. We are reading your thinking, not your word count.



5. OPTIONAL

Anything else: code, a repo, a demo, a weird side project you are proud of.





TWO RULES, PLEASE READ THEM



The word PIPELINE must appear in your application. Start your message with it. If the word is not there, your application will not be considered. No exceptions. It is how we know you read the post.



If you do not hear back from us within 72 hours, you have not been selected for an interview. We will not leave you waiting or wondering. We appreciate the time it takes to apply properly, and this is the clearest way we can respect it.



We are hiring within 1 to 2 weeks, so we look forward to hearing from you soon.



We are not looking for the most polished CV. We are looking for the right person.



Tip: make something nice out of your application, so you stand out.

title: Ecommerce Manager & Developer - Shopify
description:
E-COMMERCE MANAGER, SHOPIFY & CONVERSION

Swerv Digital, Full-time, Remote (Philippines), Long-term





Do you look at a webshop and immediately see the five things costing the business money? Do you want to work somewhere that hands you a goal instead of a task list, and where AI is not a buzzword but the actual way the work gets done?



Swerv Digital is looking for an E-commerce Manager to own Shopify across our client portfolio: builds, migrations, integrations, and a relentless conversion programme that makes stores better month after month.



Please read the whole post before applying. We ask for something specific at the bottom, and applications that skip it are not considered.





=====================================

THE BASICS

=====================================



TYPE: Full-time, long-term. We are not hiring for a project.

LOCATION: Remote. You work from the Philippines.

SCHEDULE: Fully flexible. You d
 when you work.

SALARY: 1,000 USD per month to start, paid monthly.

GROWTH: Yearly salary re-evaluation plus yearly performance bonuses.

TOOLS: We pay for everything you need, including AI subscriptions, software and apps.

TIMELINE: We are hiring within 1 to 2 weeks.

 when you work. Fully flexible.

=====================================

ABOUT SWERV DIGITAL

=====================================



Swerv Digital is a performance marketing and e-commerce agency based in Aarhus, Denmark. We are a small, tight-knit team, Viktor, Frederik and RJ, and we are looking for someone who will not just fill a role, but genuinely become part of the team for years.



RJ, one of our core tea
mbers, is Filipino. Our team already works across time zones and cultures every day, and it works well. We are direct, open and collaborative. You will not be treated as an outsourced pair of hands. You will be a member of the team with real ownership.



We work with ambitious e-commerce and service businesses across the Nordics and Europe. Real accounts, real budgets, real revenue on the line. We operate as an outsourced CMO and e-commerce manager rather than a traditional agency.



We are paid on performance. Not retainers for activity. Our income is tied to what we actually move for our clients. That shapes everything: what we build, what we ignore, and how we reward the team.





WE ARE EXTREMELY HEAVY ON AI



We are in the top 1% of companies globally in how deeply we have integrated AI into daily operations. Not "we use ChatGPT sometimes." We mean:



- An internal data and operations platform that our AI systems query directly

- 15+ live tool integrations: Shopify, Meta, Klaviyo, Google Ads, Notion, Slack, Ahrefs, Figma and more, all callable by AI agents

- Structured knowledge systems that let AI produce on-brand, compliant work at volume

- Automated weekly performance loops that pull data, apply decision rules and produce recommendations before anyone opens a spreadsheet

- Internal tools we built ourselves for creative intelligence and ad analysis



You do not need to have built any of this before. But you do need to WANT to work this way. If AI feels like a threat or a gimmick, you will be miserable here. If it feels like leverage, like the most interesting thing happening in your field, keep reading.



You will also get access to tooling and resources most people simply cannot get on their own. That is part of the deal, and part of why we care more about your potential than your CV.



Our biggest strength is flexibility. We move fast, constantly test new tools and models, and change how we work as better options emerge. We do not keep old processes for the sake of comfort.





=====================================

THE ROLE

=====================================



You will own Shopify at Swerv. That means building new stores, migrating stores onto Shopify, wiring up the integration and tracking stack, and running a continuous conversion programme across the portfolio.



We already sell Shopify builds, migrations and a monthly Shopify Unlimited service. Today that work is spread across the team. We want one person to take it, own it, and make it better than we could.



You will also be expected to build SYSTEMS, not just deliverables. Every migration you run should leave behind a better playbook. Every CRO audit should sharpen the framework. Every repetitive task should end up automated or AI-assisted. That compounding is the whole point.



On autonomy: we can give you context, priorities and access. We are not going to hand you a Figma file with every state specced out and a ticket for each button. You get a goal, for example "this store's mobile checkout is leaking, fix it" or "this client needs a B2B setup without Plus budget", and you find the path. Ask sharp questions up front, then go and deliver.



We will say it plainly: if you need detailed instructions to feel comfortable, this is the wrong job for you. That is not a criticism. Plenty of excellent people work best that way. We just cannot provide it.





=====================================

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

=====================================



SHOPIFY STORE BUILDS

Build complete stores from strategy through launch: information architecture, theme setup and customisation, product and collection structure, navigation, checkout flow, launch QA. New brands and full rebuilds of tired existing stores.



PLATFORM MIGRATIONS

Lead migrations onto Shopify, most often from WooCommerce, Magento or bespoke platforms. Product and customer data, URL and redirect mapping, SEO preservation, payment and subscription continuity, and a launch plan that does not tank traffic.



CONVERSION RATE OPTIMISATION

Run an ongoing CRO programme across the portfolio. Audit stores, find the friction, form hypotheses, prioritise by expected impact, build the tests, read results honestly, ship the winners. Product page structure and content, cart and checkout flow, upsell and cross-sell mechanics, mobile-first UX, page speed, trust elements, merchandising.



INTEGRATIONS AND APP STACK

Own the technical plumbing: Klaviyo, payment providers (Shopify Payments, Quickpay, MobilePay, Klarna), shipping and fulfilment (Shipmondo, GLS, PostNord, DAO), ERP and inventory systems, review platforms, loyalty and subscription apps, product feeds for Meta and Google. Learn which apps earn their monthly fee and which are bloat.



TRACKING AND DATA INTEGRITY

Make sure the numbers we optimise against are real. GA4, Meta Pixel and Conversions API, Google Ads conversion tracking, server-side tracking, Shopify analytics, consent mode and cookie compliance under EU rules. Broken tracking is the most expensive silent problem in e-commerce and you should treat it that way.



THEME AND FRONT-END WORK

Work confidently in Liquid, HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Customise themes, build custom sections and blocks, use metafields and metaobjects properly, and learn when a custom build beats a bought theme, and when it does not.



AI-ASSISTED SYSTEMISATION

Turn what you do into repeatable, AI-supported systems: migration playbooks, CRO audit frameworks, reusable section libraries, automated QA checks, AI workflows that let one person cover a portfolio that would normally need three. You will have real influence over our internal tooling and we expect you to use it.



CLIENT COMMUNICATION

Talk directly to clients over
 and video. Explain technical decisions in plain language, push back when a request is a bad idea, and take ownership when something breaks.





=====================================

REQUIREMENTS

=====================================



HANDS-ON SHOPIFY EXPERIENCE

You have built and worked inside real Shopify stores. You know your way around themes, products and collections, apps, and the admin. You do not need to have launched twenty stores, but you need to have actually shipped, not just studied.



FRONT-END SKILLS

Comfortable in Liquid, HTML, CSS and JavaScript. You can open a theme, understand it, and change it without breaking three other things. You are not intimidated by someone else's messy code.



CRO INSTINCT

You can look at a store and articulate what is wrong and why, from reasoning rather than a listicle of "17 CRO hacks." If you have not run formal tests before, that is fine, but you should be hungry to learn how to do it properly.



YOU GENUINELY LOVE WORKING WITH AI

You use it daily. You have opinions about which models are good at what. You have built or automated something yourself, even if it was small and scrappy. When a new tool ships, you have tried it before the newsletter about it arrives. This is not a nice-to-have here. It is how the job gets done.



FLUENT ENGLISH, NON-NEGOTIABLE

You must be genuinely fluent in written and spoken English. Our entire team communicates in English, and you will be writing to clients and joining video calls directly. If we experience a language barrier in the process, it is not a match. We would rather be blunt about this now than waste your time later.



SELF-DIRECTION

You get a goal and you run. You manage your own schedule and priorities without supervision, and you flag blockers early.



A STEEP LEARNING CURVE SOUNDS EXCITING, NOT SCARY

You want to be significantly better in six months than you are today, and you are willing to put in real effort to get there.



OWNERSHIP MENTALITY

When a store breaks on a Saturday, you care. Not because someone is watching, but because it is yours. In a team this size, there is nobody to hand it off to.



RELIABLE SETUP

Stable internet, a computer that can handle real work, a quiet space for calls.



COMMERCIAL INSTINCT

A beautiful store that does not convert is a failure. Every decision should be traceable to conversion rate, average order value, revenue or retention.





=====================================

NICE TO HAVE

=====================================



- B2B and wholesale experience: customer-specific pricing, net terms, quote flows, gated catalogues, often without Plus budgets

- Klaviyo depth: flows, segmentation, and the Shopify integration layer. We run Klaviyo across most of the portfolio.

- Custom app or Admin API development: private apps, middleware, webhook-driven automation

- Technical SEO: site structure, schema, Core Web Vitals, international and multi-market setups

- Headless or Hydrogen: we do not build headless by default, but knowing when it is genuinely right is valuable

- European market experience: you have worked with EU or Nordic e-commerce brands before





=====================================

SALARY, GROWTH AND BONUS

=====================================



- 1,000 USD per month to start, paid monthly.

- Yearly salary re-evaluation, based on what you have taken on and delivered, not on how long you have been here.

- Yearly performance bonuses. We are a performance marketing agency. We get paid mostly on the results we deliver, and we think the team should work the same way. When the agency performs, everyone is rewarded.

- Real room to grow. This role starts as owning Shopify. Where it goes depends on you. We are a small company with growing demand, and the people who take on responsibility get more of it, with the title and pay to match.

- We invest in your development. Tools, AI subscriptions, courses, experiments, we pay for them. The better you get, the better we all get.

- We pay on time. Every month. No chasing, no excuses.





=====================================

WHY JOIN SWERV DIGITAL

=====================================



You will not be one developer among twenty taking tickets from a project manager. You will be the e-commerce lead of a fast-moving agency, with direct influence over how we build, what we sell and what we deliver.



You will work on real accounts with real budgets. Because we are paid on performance, you will see exactly what your work did to the numbers. No vanity dashboards, no theatre.



You get autonomy by default, not as a reward after two years. You get a team that adopts better tools without arguing about it. And you will work at the front edge of AI-driven e-commerce operations, not reading about it, actually building it.



We are looking for someone to grow with us over years, not months.





=====================================

HOW TO APPLY

=====================================



SEND YOUR APPLICATION TO: 



This is important. Applications sent anywhere else will not be considered.



Include the following:



1. A PERSONAL INTRODUCTION

Who are you as a person? What do you like? What drives you? What are you curious about right now? This matters more to us than anything else in your application, so do not rush it and do not make it generic.



2. YOUR PREVIOUS WORK

Give us an idea of your experience: links to Shopify stores you have built or worked on, projects, jobs. Tell us specifically what YOU did.



Important: a long track record is NOT necessary. What matters is a genuine will to prove yourself and appetite for a steep learning curve. Most people have never had access to the kind of resources and tooling we work with, and we know that. We are not filtering for people who already had the opportunity. We are looking for the person who will do the most with it once they have it.



3. ONE CRO TEARDOWN

Pick any e-commerce store you like: one you have worked on, one you shop at, or any brand you find interesting. Tell us the three things you would change first, why, and what you would expect it to do to conversion rate. Keep it short. We are reading your thinking, not your word count.



4. ONE THING YOU HAVE BUILT OR AUTOMATED WITH AI

Any size. A workflow, a script, an agent, a prompt setup you actually use. Tell us what it does and why you bothered. Scrappy is fine. Honest is better.





TWO RULES, PLEASE READ THEM



The word CONVERT must appear in your application. Start your message with it. If the word is not there, your application will not be considered. No exceptions. It is how we know you read the post.



If you do not hear back from us within 72 hours, you have not been selected for an interview. We will not leave you waiting or wondering. We appreciate the time it takes to apply properly, and this is the clearest way we can respect it.



We are hiring within 1 to 2 weeks, so we look forward to hearing from you soon.



We are not looking for the most polished CV. We are looking for the right person.



Tip: make something nice out of your application, so you stand out.

Prepare meeting agendas, capture action items and track follow-up activities where required.

4. Administration & Documentation

5. Commercial & E-commerce Support

What We're Looking For

Excellent organizational skills with strong attention to detail.

title: Marketing and Operations Manager  - $1,500+ USD Monthly - eCommerce Brand
description:
We need ONE brilliant, hard-working mind to train into our next marketing leader.



Stop scrolling through mediocre opportunities. This isn't another "marketing and operations manager needed" post.



We're an 8-figure health & wellness eCommerce brand - and we're looking for one sharp, organized person to grow with us for years.



Most job posts want a specialist. We want a mind we can trust.



Here's the truth: we can teach you everything you need to know. Marketing, media buying, copywriting, funnel building, conversion optimization - all of it. What we can't teach is how to think. How to stay organized. How to work hard and figure things out without being told twice.



So if you're smart, driven, and hungry to learn - even if you're not a marketing expert yet - keep reading. That's exactly what we're hiring for.



- The Position: Marketing & Operations Manager (Trained Into Hands-On CMO)

- The Company: 8-figure health & wellness eCommerce brand (50% Germany, 50% USA)

- The Niche: Sleep, pain relief, and health products that genuinely change lives

- Location: 100% Remote

- Compensation: $1,500/month to start - with no ceiling, really. It goes as far as you take it.



What You'll Actually Be Doing



This is primarily a hands-on marketing role - with a heavy focus on writing. But you'll also help us build structure, sharpen processes, and grow our team as we scale. You'll be our right hand across the business.



Don't worry if some of this is new. As you learn, you'll take on more. Here's what your weeks will eventually look like:



- Writing scripts, ads, and copy using proven Direct Response principles (this is core - you must love writing)

- Optimizing conversion rates and running A/B tests that move real numbers

- Bringing structure and processes into how we run marketing

- Overseeing video editors - reviewing their work, giving revisions, keeping quality high

- Editing funnels with drag-and-drop tools

- Media buying across Meta & Google Ads

- Product testing using our internal templates

- Helping build the team as we grow



The first weeks and months have one goal: learn as much as humanly possible.



The end goal: you become a core operator we rely on completely.



Why This Role Is Different



We're not looking for someone to fill a seat. We're looking for someone to invest in - and build with for the long haul.



You'll be personally trained by us - an 8-figure founding team - in the exact skills that build wealth in this industry:



- Copywriting (Scripts, Advertorials, VSLs, Native Ads)

- Media Buying (Meta & Google Ads)

- Video Editing (Understanding what makes creatives convert)

- Product Testing (Using our proven internal templates)

- Funnel Building (Drag-and-drop web design)

- CVR Optimization (A/B testing and beyond)



This is a paid education worth more than any MBA. You don't need to walk in knowing all of this - you need to be the kind of person who can learn it fast.



Who We're Actually Looking For



Read this carefully, because it matters far more than your résumé:



- You're genuinely smart. You learn fast and connect dots others miss. This is the #1 thing we care about.

- You're a strong writer. Your English is flawless, and you genuinely enjoy writing. Non-negotiable.

- You're organized. You bring order to chaos. Systems and processes come naturally to you.

- You work hard. Not "I show up" hard - "I obsess over getting it right" hard.

- You're independent. You don't wait to be told what to do. You find the work and do it.

- You're loyal. You want to grow WITH a company. We have huge plans for the next few years, and we want someone who wants to be part of that story.



We've hired brilliant people from all kinds of backgrounds. What matters most is that you're sharp, driven, and already know your way around the eCommerce or online marketing world.



If you need hand-holding, this isn't for you. If you want to plant roots and build something real, keep reading.



Minimum Requirements

- You've worked at an online marketing agency OR an eCommerce brand. This is a must - you already understand how this world works. (Whatever your exact role was - marketing, ops, organization, assistant - we're open.)

- Fluent, exceptional English - you write clearly and persuasively

Comfortable with tools like Shopify, Canva, and social media (you don't need to be an expert - just comfortable and quick to learn)

- You use AI daily (Claude / ChatGPT) - not occasionally

- Fluent with modern tools (Slack, Notion, and whatever's new)

- Notice what's NOT here: years of deep marketing experience. That's what we'll teach you. We care far more about raw intelligence and work ethic than a perfect track record.



Why This Changes Your Life



For the right person, this isn't a job. It's a partnership. You start at $1,500/month, but for hard workers who prove themselves, there's no ceiling. As we grow, you grow. As the brand grows into a portfolio, so does your role - and your income.



We're looking for ONE person. A long-term partner. Someone we can pour knowledge into and build the next chapter with.



How to Apply



Keep it short and to the point. We only want three things:



1.) Your background: Did you work at an online marketing agency or an eCommerce brand? Tell us your role and what you actually accomplished.



2.) Largest team: What's the biggest team you've managed or coordinated?



3.) Motivation: What makes you want THIS role, long-term?



No long essays. Just the essentials, clearly written.



We read every application personally. Show us you're the one.



Application tip: Show, don't tell. Specific examples beat generic statements.



We're hiring ONE person for a long-term partnership. Quality applications only

Remote Sales Representative | Appointment Setter & Closer 



About Nelaur Space



Nelaur Space is a growing AI automation and web solutions agency helping service-based businesses improve their operations, attract customers, and increase sales. We provide AI automation, CRM systems, websites, and other digital solutions designed to help businesses grow efficiently.



We are looking for a confident and results-driven Sales Representative who can turn leads into qualified appointments and qualified appointments into paying clients.



Who We Are Looking For



You may be a strong fit if you are:



* Confident, persuasive, and professional on phone and Zoom calls

* Fluent in spoken and written English and preferable French too

* Comfortable contacting prospects and handling rejection

* Reliable, punctual, and consistent with daily responsibilities

* Highly organized and attentive to details

* Skilled at listening, asking the right questions, and identifying client needs

* Able to handle objections without becoming pushy or unprofessional

* Self-motivated and capable of working independently

* Driven by targets and excited about earning commissions

* Honest and accurate when reporting activities and results

* Interested in growing with a young company over the long term



Key Responsibilities



Lead Generation and Appointment Setting



* Respond quickly and professionally to inbound leads.

* Contact outbound prospects through phone,
, SMS, and social media.

* Qualify prospects based on their needs, budget, decision-making authority, and timeline.

Sales Consultations and Closing

* Present Nelaur Space’s services clearly and connect them to the prospect’s needs.

* Explain the value of our AI automation, websites, and CRM solutions.

* Handle questions and objections professionally.

CRM and Pipeline Management

title: FINANCIAL ANALYST (eCOMMERCE)
description:
FINANCIAL ANALYST (eCOMMERCE) | THE eCOMMERCE CFO



Role Type: Independent Contractor

Location: 100% Remote (AEST overlap required)

Retainer: $2,500 USD per month (Fixed, Full-Time, Exclusive)

Reports To: Judith Hobdell, Founder | The eCommerce CFO





ABOUT THE eCOMMERCE CFO



The eCommerce CFO is a specialist financial consultancy working with 7- to 8-figure eCommerce brands across Australia, the UK, the USA, and Canada. Some clients are single brands. Some are multi-entity. Every one of them sells something different.



Our job is to make eCommerce finance simple. We translate complex financial data into a clear story that founders actually understand, so that when they come to us with a financial decision, we have the data to say yes or no quickly and confidently.



Most CFOs talk about scaling. We build brands to sell, whether the founder exits or not. That distinction shapes everything we do, from how we set up the books to how we read the numbers.



I am Judith Hobdell. I have 20 years in finance, 13 in eCommerce, and I co-founded four eCommerce brands before starting The eCommerce CFO in 2023. I also built and scaled a digital marketing agency, which means I understand how the numbers connect to growth strategy. I have my own IP on how founders should manage money, and I am constantly learning and sharing that with my team.



We are not a traditional accounting firm. We are a small, high-trust team that moves with purpose.





OUR CULTURE AND VALUES



Precision over speed.

The numbers have to be right. A wrong figure in a client report is never acceptable. We take accuracy seriously because our clients make real decisions based on what we produce.



Simplicity over complexity.

We strip things back to what matters. No bloated dashboards, no overcomplicated models. Clean systems, clear data, straight-up reporting. Simple scales. Complexity kills clarity.



Curiosity over compliance.

We want people who ask "why does this look off?" not people who tick boxes and move on. Strong communication means saying what needs to be said, clearly and directly, whether that is to a bookkeeper, to me, or about a number that does not add up.



Ownership without micromanagement.

You are hired to deliver an outcome. I will not be standing over your shoulder. What I do expect is that you take full accountability for your role, your deadlines, and your output. If something goes wrong, own it. Mistakes are human and they are welcome here, because they are how we build better processes, tighten our SOPs, and improve. What is not welcome is hiding them.



Evolve or fall behind.

The eCommerce landscape changes constantly. We stay ahead of it. That means embracing AI as a tool that makes us faster and sharper. If you are not already using AI in your workflow, this environment will push you to start.



How we work day to day:

The team runs a daily check-in on Slack, sharing what they are working on and flagging anything blocking them. At the end of each week, everyone does a brief sign-off on Slack. Once a week we meet on Zoom for an HQ call to connect as a team. Everything else runs through Slack and Loom.





THE ROLE



I am looking for a Financial Analyst who can function as a "mini-me." This role sits at the intersection of a Financial Controller and an FP&A Analyst.



You will own the monthly reporting pack across multiple client accounts. You will set up and maintain live reports in Syft, run cash flow forecasts, and perform budget versus actuals analysis. You will review the data produced by the bookkeeping team, question anything that looks off, and ensure everything is accurate before it reaches me.



Every eCommerce brand is different. You will be working across varied business models, product categories, and markets simultaneously. The work is never monotonous.



I handle all client-facing calls and performance videos. Your job is to make sure the numbers behind them are flawless.



This is an exclusive arrangement. You will be working solely for The eCommerce CFO. No other clients, contracts, or income sources alongside this role.



Hiring process: Shortlisted candidates will receive pre-screening questions. Successful candidates will begin with a paid trial period before moving to a permanent retainer arrangement.





WHAT YOU WILL OWN



- Monthly Management Reports: Full P&L review and management reporting pack, accurate and complete.

- Monthly Performance Reports: Performance summaries aligned to the KPIs that matter to each brand.

- Monthly Cash Flow Forecasts: Rolling forecasts with Budget vs. Actuals variance analysis.

- Monthly KPI Reviews: Tracking and reporting on key financial and operational metrics per client.

- Live Syft Reports: Setting up and maintaining automated, live financial reports in Syft.

- Data Quality Control: Reviewing bookkeeper output, identifying errors, and coordinating amendments before reports are finalised.





WHAT WE USE



Xero - Primary accounting platform (most clients)

QuickBooks - Accounting platform (select clients)

Syft - Live financial reporting and dashboards

Google Sheets - Forecasting, budgeting, and ad hoc analysis

Slack - Daily communication, check-ins, and sign-offs

Loom - Async video communication

Notion - Internal documentation and SOPs

Zoom - Weekly HQ team call





WHO YOU ARE



Non-Negotiable:



- Minimum 5 years of experience in financial analysis, FP&A, or financial controlling.

- Proficiency in both QuickBooks and Xero. You must know both.

- Demonstrated forecasting experience. You have built rolling forecasts and cash flow models from scratch, not just maintained them.

- Advanced Google Sheets skills.

- Comfortable managing multiple client accounts simultaneously without losing accuracy or missing deadlines.

- Available to overlap with Australian Eastern Standard Time (AEST).

- Actively uses AI tools as part of your working process.

- Available exclusively for this role. No other clients or income sources.



Strongly Preferred:



- eCommerce experience (Shopify, DTC brands, marketplace sellers).

- Experience in a fractional CFO, outsourced finance, or multi-client environment.

- Familiarity with Syft, Fathom, or Spotlight Reporting.



The Right Person:



You take genuine pride in your work. You are inquisitive, not passive. You thrive with autonomy and take ownership of your outcomes. You want to grow as a finance professional by being close to CFO-level decision-making, not to build your own agency on the side. You communicate clearly, raise issues early, and treat deadlines as non-negotiable.





WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT



- This is not a bookkeeping role.

- This is not a client-facing role.

- This is not the right role if you want to maintain other clients or build your own business alongside it.





HOW TO APPLY



To be considered, please submit all of the following:



1. Use the subject line: "Pineapple" (applications without this will not be opened).

2. Your updated resume or CV.

3. A short personal note, not a generic cover letter, explaining why you want to work with me, Judith Hobdell, and what genuinely excites you about this environment. I will know if it is copy-pasted.

4. Your Myers-Briggs (MBTI) personality type (4 letters only, for example INTJ). No screenshots needed.

5. At least one sample report or dashboard you have built. Redact any confidential client information.



Shortlisted candidates will receive pre-screening questions based on their sample report. A paid trial period precedes any permanent arrangement.





The eCommerce CFO | Remote | AEST | Built to sell. Whether you exit or not.

title: Fast-Paced STR Designer (Architecture Background Required, 5-Day Turnaround)
description:
We are a premium short-term rental (STR) design firm specializing in ROI-driven transformations with a 5-business-day turnaround model. We operate on a structured, template-based system built for speed, precision, and scalability. We're hiring 3–4 production-focused designers who thrive in deadline-driven environments.

Our designers work across a variety of project types and aesthetics — not the same style on repeat. You'll get to see your designs come to life: our clients typically complete installs 6–12 weeks after design delivery, so your work becomes real spaces, not just renderings that sit in a folder. Accountability & Ownership

Coordinate freelancers and vendors (designers, photographers, copywriters, content creators)

Daily & Weekly Tasks

Perform ongoing listing audits and implement improvements (titles, bullets, images, backend, A+, attributes)

Analyze competitors for positioning and conversion opportunities (without product scouting)

Track performance: sessions, conversion rate, CTR, sales rank, review velocity, return rate

Listing updates with ad strategy

Inventory levels with promo and demand forecasts

Creative needs with conversion goals

Manage reporting and ensure action items are executed consistently

Create a repeatable system for ongoing listing improvement and CRO

Improve customer loyalty and retention through stronger messaging, brand voice, and content

Develop SOPs for listing updates, creative briefs, review management, and performance reporting

KPI 1: Listing Quality & Organic Performance

Objective: Improve listing visibility and discoverability through optimization



Metrics:

Keyword indexing coverage + organic rank improvements

CTR improvements (Search + ads-supported)

Reduction in suppressed/invalid attributes and listing issues

Run keyword research and update listings using Helium 10 + market analysis

Maintain listing audit checklist and optimization tracker

title: Spanish Phone Support
description:
Remote Bilingual Legal Intake Coordinator (English/Spanish) — Full Time, Long-Term



### About the Role

We are a busy U.S. law firm and we are building a 24/7 client-intake desk. When someone calls

our firm, they are often in a stressful legal situation and they need a calm, professional human

to answer — not a voi
. Your job is to be that human. You will answer calls live, return

missed calls fast, monitor messages and online forms, and make sure no potential client ever

falls through the cracks.



This is a long-term, full-time role with a stable schedule. We pay on time, every time, and we

invest in people who take ownership.



### What You'll Do Every Shift

- Answer incoming calls live through our internet phone system (GoTo softphone)

- Return every missed call with a callback attempt **within 5–10 minutes** — this is the most

important measure of success in this role

- Monitor and respond to voi
s and text messages

- Monitor and respond to online intake form submissions (through Clio)

- Take clear intake information: caller name, phone,
, location, type of legal matter,

urgency, and how they found us

- Enter and update every contact in our intake system so nothing is lost

- Schedule consultations on the firm calendar

- Recognize urgent matters (jail/arrest, court deadline, immigration detention, safety issue)

and escalate them immediately using our written escalation list

- Complete a written shift handoff at the end of every shift



> **Important:** You are NOT giving legal advice. You gather information and connect people to the

> right person on our legal team. We train you on exactly what to say.



### Must-Have Requirements

- **Fully fluent in BOTH English and Spanish** — speaking, listening, reading, and writing.

You will switch between languages on live calls. This is non-negotiable.

- Clear, warm, professional phone voice with a neutral accent in both languages

- Reliable high-speed internet **plus a backup internet source** (mobile hotspot or second

provider) — you cannot go offline mid-shift

- A quiet, dedicated work space with no background noise

- A working computer and a noise-cancelling headset

- Strong attention to detail and great note-taking

- Comfortable using web-based software (we train you on GoTo and Clio)

- Dependable and punctual — shifts start on time, every time

- Able to work the **same fixed schedule long-term** (see Schedule below)



### Nice to Have (Not Required)

- Prior experience in customer service, call center, reception, or virtual assistant work

- Prior experience with a law firm, medical office, or other professional services

- Experience with GoTo, RingCentral, or similar VoIP/softphone systems

- Experience with Clio, Clio Grow, or any CRM/intake software



### Schedule

> **[SWAP this block per shift you are hiring for]**

This role covers **[OVERNIGHT: 10:00 PM – 6:00 AM U.S. Mountain Time]**, Sunday through Thursday.

(Other shifts available — tell us your availability and we'll match you.)

You must be able to commit to this schedule consistently. Coverage is 24/7/365, so weekend and

holiday shifts are part of the rotation and are paid the same.



### Compensation

- Paid monthly, on time

- Long-term role with raises based on performance

- We are looking for someone to grow with us for years, not weeks





To apply, please do ALL of the following. Applications that skip any step will not be reviewed:



1. Watch this video: 
/shorts/oF4x3PdmJaY?is=EiMrMsBwwwrKiIqf

2. Follow the instructions in the video



We review every complete application personally. Thank you — we're excited to meet you.

title: Reddit Creative Strategist & Copywriter
description:
About the Role:

Karmic is a marketing agency that builds and runs organic and paid content programs on Reddit for a portfolio of consumer brand clients. As a Reddit Creative Strategist, you’ll own the day-to-day creative engine behind our clients’ owned subreddits, spotting what’s resonating on the platform right now and shipping polished, native-feeling content that doesn’t read like it came from an AI.

This is a hands-on creative and editorial role, not a hands-off one. You’ll lead content strategy, writing, editing, and posting daily across multiple clients’ communities.



What You’ll Do:

- Lead content strategy and writing for each client’s subreddit, drawing on relevant viral Reddit posts, real-time news, and client content to create original, engaging thread ideas grounded in what’s trending right now.

- Use AI tools to draft first-pass Reddit posts efficiently, treating AI output as a starting point rather than a finished product.

- Execute significant copy editing on AI-drafted content to eliminate any evidence of AI writing, rebuild genuine emotional resonance, and craft hooks that open curiosity loops to maximize engagement, since a post’s performance lives or dies on its first line.

- Execute posting and ongoing maintenance of client threads, building and growing each community over time.

- Stay closely attuned to the culture and norms of each subreddit you work in, adjusting tone and format so content reads as native rather than promotional.

- Monitor content performance and feed learnings back into the broader strategy.



What We’re Looking For:

- 3+ years of experience in content marketing, growth marketing, or brand strategy, ideally in a writing-heavy capacity rather than an oversight-only role.

- Exceptional written English skills.

- Strong, demonstrable editing instincts: you can take a rough or AI-generated draft and make it read like a real person wrote it, catching not just obvious AI patterns but anything that just sounds unnatural.

- Genuine fluency in Reddit as a platform: how different subreddits’ cultures and norms differ, what makes a post get buried versus take off, and what reads as authentic versus promotional.

- Comfort working across multiple client accounts and brands at once, adapting voice and subject matter for each.

- Sharp copywriting instincts, particularly for hooks and headlines that create real curiosity without tipping into clickbait.

- Ability to work efficiently with AI drafting tools while holding a high editorial bar, treating AI as a tool rather than a shortcut around craft.

- Comfortable with a fast-moving, real-time content cadence tied to news cycles and trending conversations.

- Experience working with tech brands and early-stage U.S. startups.

- Ability to work independently.



Nice to Have:

- Experience writing content in a marketing agency.

- Experience running or growing a brand’s (or your own) presence on Reddit specifically, not just general social media.

- Familiarity with content performance metrics beyond vanity numbers, such as comment quality, share of voice, and sentiment.

- Background in copywriting, journalism, or content marketing.



ALL APPLICATIONS MUST CONTAIN REAL WRITING SAMPLES FROM THE LAST 6 MONTHS - PLEASE INCLUDE

title: Sales Representative
description:
Role: Independent Sales Representative  

Engagement Type: Independent Contractor (Monthly Retainer + Commission) 

Work Arrangement: Remote 

Reports To: Chief Operating Officer (COO) 

About Ro&® 

Ro&® is an Australian technology company specializing in AI-native Physical Risk Intelligence™ 

solutions. Our platform transforms video, sensor, and operational data into real-time 

intelligence that enables organizations to improve safety, security, compliance, and operational 

decision-making. 

As we continue to expand globally, we are seeking experienced independent sales professionals 

who are passionate about opening new commercial opportunities and introducing innovative 

technology solutions to organizations across multiple industries. 

About the Role 

This is an Independent Contractor role operating under a monthly retainer plus commission 

structure. The successful contractor will be responsible for generating new business 

opportunities, identifying and engaging prospective clients and Channel Partners, conducting 

introductory commercial discussions, arranging product demonstrations, and supporting 

opportunities through the sales process. 

Key Responsibilities 

1. Sales & Prospecting 

• Research and identify prospective organizations aligned with the Company's target 

market. 

• Identify executive-level decision-makers and key business contacts. 

• Generate qualified business opportunities through cold calling,
 outreach, LinkedIn 

prospecting, referrals, networking, and other independent sales activities. 

• Build, manage, and maintain an active pipeline of qualified prospects. 

• Secure introductory meetings and product demonstrations with qualified organizations. 

2. Sales Activities 

• Conduct introductory commercial discussions with prospective organizations. 

• Present the Company's products, services, and value proposition. 

• Understand prospective client requirements and determine business suitability. 

• Arrange product demonstrations and commercial meetings with the COO. 

• Maintain professional follow-up throughout the qualification process. 

3. Opportunity Management 

• Qualify opportunities in accordance with the Company's commercial criteria. 

• Maintain accurate CRM records and sales activity updates. 

• Progress qualified opportunities through the sales pipeline. 

• Refer qualified opportunities to the COO for commercial discussions, negotiations, and 

contract execution. 

• Prepare pipeline updates and activity reports as required. 

4. Sales Support 

• Professionally represent Ro&® during approved networking events, conferences, 

webinars, and business development activities. 

• Contribute market intelligence, customer insights, and competitor information that 

supports business growth. 

• Maintain current knowledge of the Company's products, services, target industries, and 

competitive landscape. 

5. Performance Expectations 

• Consistently generate qualified business opportunities. 

• Maintain an active and healthy sales pipeline. 

• Achieve agreed business development objectives and performance targets. 

• Demonstrate professionalism, integrity, ethical conduct, and sound commercial 

judgment. 

• Independently manage prospecting activities while maintaining accurate sales records 

and CRM updates. 

Authority 

The Independent Sales Representative is authorized to: 

• Identify prospective organizations. 

• Initiate commercial discussions. 

• Conduct introductory sales presentations. 

• Arrange product demonstrations. 

• Progress qualified opportunities through the sales pipeline. 

• Refer qualified opportunities to the COO for commercial review. 

The Independent Sales Representative is not authorized to: 

• Approve pricing, discounts, or commercial terms. 

• Negotiate or execute contracts on behalf of the Company. 

• Make financial commitments or legally bind the Company. 

• Approve commercial agreements or partnership arrangements. 

Qualifications 

Education 

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Management, Information Technology, 

Communications, or a related discipline is preferred. 

Equivalent professional experience demonstrating the required competencies will also be 

considered. 

Experience 

The successful candidate should possess: 

• Minimum eight (8) years of proven experience in B2B sales, business development, 

enterprise sales, technology sales, or a related commercial role. 

• Demonstrated success generating new business opportunities through outbound 

prospecting and relationship development. 

• Experience conducting professional sales presentations, introductory commercial 

discussions, and product demonstrations. 

• Experience working with a U.S.-based technology company or supporting U.S.-based 

clients within the technology sector is highly preferred. 

• Strong preference for candidates with established commercial networks or proven sales 

experience within the security, technology, AI, software, cybersecurity, risk 

management, or related industries. 

• Demonstrated ability to engage executive-level stakeholders and business decision

makers. 

• Experience using CRM platforms, sales engagement tools, and modern business 

applications. 

• Experience operating independently within remote or international business 

environments is advantageous. 

Knowledge, Skills and Competencies 

The successful candidate should demonstrate: 

• Strong business development and outbound prospecting capabilities. 

• Excellent consultative selling and commercial communication skills. 

• Strong networking and relationship-building abilities. 

• Excellent verbal and written English communication skills. 

• Professional presentation and interpersonal skills. 

• Strong commercial awareness and sound business judgment. 

• High level of integrity, professionalism, accountability, and self-motivation. 

• Excellent planning, organization, and time management skills. 

• Highly tech-savvy with the ability to quickly adopt CRM platforms, sales engagement 

technologies, AI-powered productivity tools, and modern business applications. 

• Ability to operate independently and consistently generate commercial opportunities 

within a performance-based environment. 

Nice to Have 

• Existing professional network within the security, AI, software, technology, cybersecurity, 

infrastructure, or risk management industries. 

• Experience selling SaaS, AI platforms, enterprise software, cybersecurity, cloud-based 

solutions, or video intelligence technologies. 

• Experience working with Australian or U.S.-based technology companies. 

• International B2B sales experience. 

• Experience operating as an independent sales representative.  

Compensation 

This is an Independent Contractor engagement compensated through a combination of a 

monthly retainer and commission. 

The monthly retainer is provided in recognition of the contractor's ongoing business 

development activities, including prospecting, lead generation, relationship building, pipeline 

management, and other agreed sales responsibilities. 

In addition to the monthly retainer, the contractor will be eligible to earn commissions on 

successfully completed commercial opportunities in accordance with the Independent 

Contractor Agreement and the applicable Commission Structure. 

The monthly retainer and commission arrangement will be discussed during the recruitment 

process and formalized within the contractor's engagement documentation.

• At least one year of outbound cold-calling, lead-generation, collections, customer-service, appointment-setting, or phone-sales experience

• Excellent spoken and written English

• Clear, professional, and confident phone presence

• Ability to build rapport quickly

• Strong listening and follow-up-question skills

• Strong attention to detail

• Excellent note-taking and organizational skills

• Experience using a CRM or lead-management platform

• Dependable, coachable, self-motivated, and results-oriented

• Comfortable receiving feedback and participating in call reviews



Preferred Experience - Experience in one or more of the following areas is strongly preferred:

• Real estate wholesaling

• Distressed-property acquisitions

• Manual skip tracing

• Pipedrive, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or a similar CRM

• Prior Upwork experience with positive client reviews



Real estate experience is preferred but may not be required for an exceptional candidate with strong outbound calling, investigative, or relationship-building experience.



Ideal Candidate Profile - The ideal candidate is:

• Curious and comfortable asking follow-up questions

• Persistent without being aggressive

• Personable and emotionally intelligent

• Patient with complicated situations

• Comfortable speaking with multiple people connected to the same property

• Able to recognize important context clues

• Resourceful when information is incomplete

• Organized and disciplined with follow-up

• Comfortable being measured by both productivity and quality

• Interested in learning distressed real estate, probate, ownership, and title-related concepts



Technology and Workspace Requirements - Applicants must have:

• A reliable computer or laptop

• A professional noise-canceling headset

• A quiet and distraction-free workspace

• Stable high-speed internet

• Ability to use online research tools, spreadsheets, calling systems,
, and CRM software

• Ability to participate in video meetings and training sessions



Calling and Performance Expectations - This is a performance-based role. However, DPA conversations can vary significantly in length and complexity. Performance will be evaluated using both activity and quality standards.



Performance measurements may include:

• Outbound call attempts

• Number of contacts reached

• Attendance and schedule adherence

• Call quality and professionalism

• Responsiveness to coaching and training



The goal is not simply to make the highest number of calls. The goal is to identify the right people, gather the right information, and move qualified opportunities forward.

Expected activity levels will be adjusted based on list quality, contact rates, call duration, research needs, and the complexity of each assigned file.



Compensation

• $5 per hour

• Approximately 30 hours per week

• $250 commission for each qualifying transaction that successfully closes

• Additional performance bonuses may be offered for qualified opportunities, successful acquisitions handoffs, appointments, or consistent achievement of performance standards



Commission eligibility, lead attribution, qualifying-deal requirements, payment timing, and performance-bonus rules will be provided in writing before employment begins.



This is a direct-hire opportunity and not an entry-level training position.

 using the following subject line:

DPA OUTREACH SPECIALIST

Please include:

title: Real Estate Closing Coordinator (U.S. Residential)
description:
About AIK Property Group



AIK Property Group is a residential real estate development company based in New York. We acquire, renovate, and sell homes while working closely with buyers, sellers, lenders, attorneys, title companies, municipalities, nonprofit organizations, and housing grant agencies.



We're looking for an experienced Real Estate Closing Coordinator who can take ownership of the transaction process and ensure every deal moves efficiently from contract execution to a successful closing.



This is not an entry-level position. We're seeking someone who already understands U.S. residential real estate transactions and can demonstrate that experience.



---



Your Mission



Your job is simple:



Keep every transaction moving toward closing.



You'll be responsible for coordinating multiple active transactions, anticipating issues before they become delays, following up relentlessly, and ensuring every party involved remains accountable.



You should always know:



* Which transactions are on track.

* Which transactions are at risk.

* What documents or approvals are outstanding.

* Who is responsible for the next action.

* What needs to happen today to move every file forward.



We're looking for someone who takes ownership—not someone who waits for instructions.



---



Key Responsibilities



* Coordinate residential real estate transactions from executed contract through closing.

* Manage multiple active transactions while maintaining accuracy and organization.

* Maintain transaction timelines and monitor all critical deadlines.

* Coordinate with buyers, sellers, lenders, attorneys, title companies, municipalities, contractors, grant administrators, and internal team members.

* Collect, organize, review, and track all required transaction documentation.

* Proactively identify and resolve issues that could delay closing.

* Maintain complete and organized transaction records.

* Provide accurate and timely updates on every active transaction.

* Ensure every transaction continues progressing until funding and closing are complete.



---



# What We're Looking For



The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of:



* U.S. residential real estate transactions

* Contract-to-close coordination

* Title and attorney coordination

* Lender communication and requirements

* Closing timelines and deadlines

* Document collection and compliance

* Managing multiple transactions simultaneously



You should also be comfortable learning and working within AIK Property Group's systems, including the **Greater Capital Association of REALTORS® (GCAR)** platform and other transaction management tools used by our team.



---



# Minimum Qualifications



* Minimum **3 years of experience** coordinating U.S. residential real estate transactions.

* Proven ability to successfully manage multiple active transactions simultaneously.

* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

* Strong organizational, time management, and problem-solving abilities.

* Highly dependable, responsive, and detail-oriented.

* Able to work independently with minimal supervision.



---



# Application Requirements



We value demonstrated experience over résumé claims.



To be considered, your application must include all of the following:



* Updated résumé.

* Brief cover letter summarizing your real estate closing experience.

* Supporting evidence that demonstrates your transaction coordination experience.



Examples of acceptable supporting evidence include:



* Redacted closing checklists you managed.

* Sample transaction timelines.

* Screenshots of transaction pipelines or dashboards (with confidential information removed).

* Process documentation you created or maintained.

* Other work samples that clearly demonstrate your role in coordinating residential real estate closings.



Please remove or redact all confidential client information before submitting any documentation.



Applications submitted without supporting evidence will not be reviewed.



---



# Interview Process



Qualified applicants will be invited to participate in a Transaction Case Review



During this session, you will be asked to share your screen and walk us through a completed transaction that you coordinated (using a redacted file or recreated workflow if necessary).



You should be prepared to explain:



* How the transaction progressed from contract to closing.

* The major milestones and deadlines.

* Challenges encountered during the process.

* How those challenges were resolved.

* How you kept all parties accountable.

* How you organize and prioritize multiple active transactions.



This is not intended to test memorization. We want to understand how you think, communicate, solve problems, and manage real-world transactions.



---



# What Success Looks Like



A successful Closing Coordinator:



* Keeps transactions moving without constant supervision.

* Anticipates issues before they become closing delays.

* Maintains proactive communication with every stakeholder.

* Keeps organized and accurate transaction files.

* Meets deadlines consistently.

* Takes ownership of every transaction from contract to closing.



When someone asks about the status of a file, you already know the answer.



---



# Who Will Thrive in This Role



You'll be a great fit if you are:



* Proactive.

* Organized.

* Reliable.

* Detail-oriented.

* Accountable.

* Calm under pressure.

* Comfortable making decisions and taking ownership.

* Committed to delivering successful closings—not simply completing assigned tasks.



---



# How to Apply



Please
 your application to:







**Required
 Subject Format**



**Closing Coordinator – F. LAST NAME**



**Example:** `Closing Coordinator – J. DELA CRUZ`



Applications that do not follow the required subject format or do not include the requested supporting documentation may not be considered.



---



Our Hiring Philosophy



At AIK Property Group, we hire based on capability, ownership, reliability, and demonstrated experience—not résumé claims alone.



If you're someone who takes pride in keeping transactions organized, solving problems before they become obstacles, and ensuring every closing reaches the finish line, we'd love to hear from you.
